articleTitle: Application of graphene in semiconductor power electronic devices
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In today's society, silicon is the primary material in semiconductor manufacturing and dominates the semiconductor industry market. However, since the discovery of graphene materials, researchers have been studying it for several years. Its special properties and high-quality electronic characteristics have made graphene widely used in the electronic and electrical semiconductor industry. However, graphene also has many defects that make it impossible for contemporary technology to fully replace silicon, so graphene cannot be fully used in the semiconductor industry. This article will discuss the special electronic properties of graphene, such as electron mobility, conductivity, and ductility. Additionally, it will explore where graphene is used in the field of electronics and appliances today. Furthermore, this paper will discuss the advantages of graphene over silicon which was the leading material for electronic appliances, and discuss its defects in different aspects and the problems by these defects for analyzing graphene is considered to be a revolutionary semiconductor material but cannot be widely used.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of position control system for CNC linear motion table using PID control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This study provides a comprehensive examination of the control performance of an Improved PID Controller within CNC linear motion table position control systems. The study focuses on evaluating the efficacy of the Improved PID Controller in enhancing position control and its anti-interference ability, and addressing the limitations of traditional PID control, such as slow response to setpoint changes, high overshoot, and steady-state error. The improved PID Controller builds upon the basic principles of the PID controller by incorporating modifications such as adaptive tuning algorithms, feedforward control, and dynamic setpoint weighting to enhance its performance. Through comprehensive simulations, the control function of the Improved PID Controller is analyzed, revealing its ability to regulate position accurately and efficiently. Simulation outcomes illustrate the efficiency of the Improved PID Controller in attaining accurate position control, exhibiting superior performance compared to conventional PID controllers. Additionally, the analysis highlights the Improved PID Controller's robustness against external interference, ensuring stable operation even in the presence of disturbances. Through rigorous parameter determination and correction, the Improved PID Controller is optimized to suit the dynamics of the CNC linear motion table position control system, resulting in improved control accuracy and stability. This research contributes to advancing the field of control systems engineering by providing insights into the practical application and performance of the Improved PID Controller in CNC linear motion table position control systems, thereby paving the way for enhanced precision and reliability in industrial automation processes.

articleTitle: Application of image sensors in autonomous driving systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In this paper, the author seeks to understand how image sensors are utilized in an ADS. Particularly, it focuses on the manner in which image sensors acquire the environmental information necessary for safe and efficient vehicular operation. The work contrasts the two prominent image sensors: the CCD and CMOS detectors, focusing on the shift from CCDs to CMOS in ADSs since the latter is less power hungry, works at a faster rate, and is easier to implement. The paper then goes further and compares new CMOS sensor technologies such as High Dynamic Range (HDR), Noise reduction and Event-driven Vision Sensors which enhance system performance under dynamic situations. Furthermore, the study also looks into the use of image sensors in the perception, decision-making, and control of ADS where the communication and integration with other sensors are brought up in creating a complete model of the surroundings. The paper concludes with a discussion on the use of image sensors in ADSs, particularly in enabling parking and navigating complex weather conditions.

articleTitle: Dynamic wireless charging system for electric vehicles analysis of magnetic coupling structure
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Given how quickly the electric vehicle market is expanding, the existing charging facilities are in short supply. Wire charging technology has the disadvantages of being inflexible, inefficient, and occupying a lot of space. In order to adapt to the current development status, wireless charging technology has been proposed. Depending on the application scenario. It is split into static wireless charging and dynamic wireless charging. Due to the existence of inductive impedance in the circuit during the energy transmission process, which reduces the power factor, it is necessary to introduce compensation topology. In contrast to static wireless charging, dynamic wireless charging technology pays more attention to the stability of the output. This article focuses on dynamic wireless charging technology, outlines four types of compensation topology structures in wireless charging systems, and based on these four structures, discusses the lasting current and lasting voltage output of LCC-LCL and LCC-LCC/S type topology structures. It analyzes the impact of the selection of the transmitter end compensation inductance value on the output characteristics, in order to achieve a high power yet efficient wireless energy transmission method.

articleTitle: Design of smart pill box using Multisim simulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the aging of society and the increase in the number of chronic disease patients, the importance of medication management has become increasingly prominent. Because of the dependence of patients' self-discipline, traditional medication often leads to missing or mistaking of drugs, which affects the therapeutic effect and the health of patients. To address this challenge, the smart pill box has emerged as an innovative medical device designed to provide a more efficient and reliable medication management solution. The smart pill box has been designed with a variety of customized features that displays on some seven-segment displays, such as time display, battery, alarm clock reminder and countdown function to enhance the user experience. The basic circuit design and simulations were conducted using Multisim software to ensure that each function operates correctly and without interference. While the feasibility has been verified experimentally, issues such as digital jumping and poor circuit integration still require further optimization. Through the integration of these functions, the smart pill box not only improves the user's medication compliance, but also optimizes the drug efficacy and provides a comprehensive and reliable medication management system.

articleTitle: A license plate recognition system based on CNN neural network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In the context of advancing modern highway transportation and the automotive industry, license plate recognition technology has become crucial for fulfilling the demands of traffic and safety management within intelligent transportation systems. This article aims to use convolutional neural networks to accelerate the recognition of car license plates. Firstly, the collected images are preprocessed by filtering and denoising. Secondly, perform morphological operations on the image, use license plate correction, and use contour detection to determine the position of the license plate. Then adopt appropriate methods for character segmentation. Ultimately, convolutional neural networks are employed for the recognition of license plate characters. The model test results show that the comprehensive model accuracy of the license plate recognition system is 91.2%, with high accuracy. Compared with ordinary license plate recognition systems, it has higher corresponding speed and recognition ability. This improvement is significant for real-time applications. With the continuous progress of technology and the expansion of applications, license plate recognition will play a more important role in smart transportation, providing more efficient and intelligent solutions for the construction of smart cities.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of speed current double closed-loop DC speed regulation system based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The speed current double closed-loop direct current (DC) speed regulation system is a widely used DC speed regulation system, which has the advantages of a wide speed regulation range, good stability, and high precision. Under the condition of meeting the performance requirements of all aspects, the design scheme of current code type 1 and speed code type 2 under the valve-motor (V-M) system is adopted, and the three-phase full-control bridge rectifier circuit is used as a user port function (UPE) to act as the control loop. Under the simulation of MATLAB, the double closed-loop system of current type 1 and speed type 2 obtained by the V-M system meets the requirements, and the results are successfully verified. The potential significance of studying the speed current double closed-loop DC speed regulation system is to achieve compatibility with a wide speed regulation range, high stability, and high precision, which can meet the high requirements of precision manufacturing, aerospace, and other fields. With the development of industrial automation and intelligent manufacturing, the results of this study are expected to have value in more fields such as industrial production, vehicles, and ships.

articleTitle: Applications of micro-electromechanical systems in robot control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the rapid changes in science and technology, robotics has gradually moved from science fiction to reality. However, progress in this field has not been easy, and the way of robot control methods has always been a key constraint on their development. Traditional robot control methods often rely on complex programming and pre-determined paths, which are stable, but their precision and autonomy are stretched when faced with complex and changing environments. This limitation not only restricts the application of robots in certain highly sophisticated fields but also affects the user experience and the popularity of robotics. To break through this bottleneck, this paper explores the application of micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) technology in robot motion control. MEMS technology brings new possibilities for robot control with its tiny size, high precision, and high degree of integration. By reviewing the development of robot control methods, the evolution from the initial mechanical control to the modern electronic control and then to the future intelligent control can be seen. MEMS technology is a key part of this evolutionary process. In this paper, the application cases of MEMS devices in robot control are analysed in depth to demonstrate their advantages in improving the precision of robot movement and enhancing autonomy and adaptability. Through these cases, the effectiveness and potential of MEMS devices in the actual operation of robots can be seen.

articleTitle: Advances in supercapacitors and IT systematic analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Supercapacitors, also known as electrochemical capacitors, have emerged as crucial components in the realm of energy storage technology driven by advancements in science and technology. Unlike conventional batteries, which prioritize energy density but often face challenges such as limited power density, slow charge/discharge rates, and finite cycle life, supercapacitors offer distinct advantages. They are renowned for their high-power density, rapid charge/discharge capabilities, and extended cycle life. These attributes make them highly promising for applications in electric vehicles, renewable energy systems, and consumer electronics. This review aims to provide a comprehensive exploration of supercapacitors by delving into their fundamental principles, optimization strategies, and application potentials. It will discuss the electrochemical mechanisms underlying electrochemical double-layer capacitors and pseudo capacitors, contrasting them with traditional battery technologies. Furthermore, it will analyse various electrode materials and electrolytes, highlighting their impacts on supercapacitor performance. Optimization techniques related to electrode structure, electrode-electrolyte interfaces, and module design will also be examined. Lastly, the review will explore the diverse applications of supercapacitors, from enhancing transportation efficiency to improving energy storage solutions and advancing consumer electronics. By consolidating current knowledge, this review aims to stimulate further research and innovation in supercapacitor development and deployment.

articleTitle: Optimal gain rectangular aperture horn antenna design based on 2.4 GHz
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In recent years, radio waves based on the 2.4 GHz operating frequency have been widely used in mobile communications, but still face challenges such as signal attenuation and interference in high-speed data transmission and long-distance transmission. In addition, with the increasing requirements on high-frequency bandwidth and antenna performance, the research and optimization of rectangular aperture horn antennas have received increasing attention. In order to tackle these problems, the WR430 rectangular waveguide, measuring 4.30 inches in width and 2.15 inches in height, feeds the horn with a rectangular aperture horn antenna that operates exceptionally well in the 2.4 GHz band. The coaxial line, which has a characteristic impedance of 50 Ω, introduces the excitation signals. In order to enhance performance, the antenna construction and characteristics are additionally optimized through simulation and analysis using Ansys HFSS. The simulation results show that the designed antenna has 37.9% bandwidth and 19.6dB maximum gain in 2.4GHz band. By applying it to the 2.4GHz band, it can meet the demand of high gain antenna in high-speed wireless communication and improve the coverage and transmission rate of the system. Its benefits include a straightforward design, a broad bandwidth, a substantial power capacity, and ease of usage and adjustment.

articleTitle: Design of 1400-1450nm fiber laser based on MATLAB numerical simulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This study aims to design a bismuth-doped fiber laser with an operating wavelength in the range of 1400-1450nm to solve the problem of limited spectral coverage in the current optical fiber field. This study uses the quantum electrodynamics model of doped bismuth ions to obtain the power propagation equation representing laser power propagation in optical fibers and the rate equation representing electron transition rate, and uses MATLAB to write a program to calculate and analyze the propagation behavior of pump light and laser in the optical fiber. Through experimental verification, the laser achieves efficient laser output in the E band. The theoretical pump threshold power is 0.1005W, and the laser power is linearly related to the pump power. The results of the research shows that the laser designed by using bismuth ions as doping particles has potential application value in communications in extended band, and can significantly improve the performance of optical fiber communications, which provide more options for future high-speed and large-capacity communications.

articleTitle: Design of smart home energy supply scheme based on wireless charging technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The study is aimed to explore and optimize wireless scheme in the sector of smart home. This paper first describes the development history and current scientific research achievements of wireless charging in the sector of smart homes, and then discusses the problems and challenges that the current program focuses on, such as high heat and low power of wireless charging. Then, based on the existing research results, the paper focuses on the optimization scheme of wireless charging in the field of smart homes, including optimizing the design of a mobile wireless charging base to improve the application range of wireless charging. Reducing wireless charging heat to reduce the negative impact of high temperature on the equipment. Improving the power and efficiency of wireless charging and optimize the optimization and control algorithms of the transmitter and receiver to improve the applicability of smart home wireless charging applications. This paper aims to improve the convenience, applicability, and intelligence of wireless charging technology in the smart home sector by analyzing the research results of existing wireless charging technology in the field of smart homes and proposing optimization and innovation schemes.

articleTitle: The elimination of harmonics generated in PV system connected to grid
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Power transmission harmonics result in increased voltage drops in cables, distorted voltage waveforms at the ends of long supply cables, high harmonic content voltage at the neutral point of three-phase systems, damaged power factor correction capacitor banks connected across power supply cables, and rising natural current that, even in cases with balanced three-phase loads, poses a fire risk. This article examines harmonic distortion, evaluates its analysis, and determines how well harmonics are removed. As a result, both passive and active methods are used to minimize the harmonics of direct current (dc) and alternating current (ac), with passive methods often emphasizing impedance visualization. It is possible to modify the emissions from the complete set as well as the harmonic emissions from each individual inverter. This review was written to provide harmonics mitigation algorithms and offer methods for locating and measuring harmonic distortion. Consequently, two categories of methods exist for lowering these harmonics: the dc-side and ac-side methods, which include both passive and active approaches. The testing of ocular resistance will be prioritized by the passive methods.

articleTitle: Analysing and optimizing existing problems of wireless charging
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Wireless charging technology is the most innovative and convenient charging method among the existing charging methods, which has a huge development prospect. The main principles of wireless charging include the magnetic effect of current and electromagnetic induction. The wireless charging uses these two principles to convert the original charging through the charging line into charging through the electromagnetic energy transfer, getting rid of the bondage of the charging line. Based on the current status of wireless charging industry, this paper analyses the three main problems of wireless charging at present, which are slow charging efficiency, high charging loss and serious charging heat. Through collecting various cases, the three problems of wireless charging are optimized. Finally, the optimization method of each problem is summarized. The optimization methods provided in this article can help practitioners solve the above problems. The analysis of the three problems in this paper can give researchers further inspiration to solve more difficult and complex problems in the future.

articleTitle: A research of the status of the PWM of NPC three-level inverter
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With science and technology development, the application of inverters in the AC frequency conversion speed regulation system has become a hot research field. Among them, the three-level inverter has received extensive attention from scholars of its low requirements for the withstand voltage level of the device, high switching frequency, smooth output waveform, etc., and the three-level inverter also makes it possible to make the voltage inverter large capacity and high performance. Therefore, the research and development of three-level inverters is of great significance both in technology and practical application. This paper first describes the development of three-level inverters and two modulation methods (SPWM and SVPWM), then introduces the principles of three-level inverters and the two modulations. Next, it summarizes several typical modulation strategies of NPC three-level inverters, followed by comparing and analyzing their advantages and disadvantages. The final part of this paper makes a summary of this text and discusses the future trends and possible research in this area.

articleTitle: Doubly fed induction generator-based wind power generation: advanced controls and applications
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Wind power has received a lot of attention due to the growing demand for electricity and the requirements of sustainable development. In wind power plants, doubly fed induction generators (DFIG) are commonly used since their outstanding efficiency and various control choices. DFIG based wind turbines (WT) need more complex, powerful control methods to increase power production performance and reliability of the system, and powerful controllers are an essential component of powerful control strategies. The study on various types of controllers is reviewed and compared in this work. These controllers are used in DFIG based WT systems for stabilization and maximum power extraction. Furthermore, this study explores WT system controller research trends for the future.

articleTitle: Operational amplifiers in electrocardiogram devices
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This paper describes a superior performance operational amplifier developed that applied into electrocardiogram (ECG). The performance of the op-amp is improved in several areas: lower power dissipation, reduced amplifier noise, and enhanced signal accuracy. By combining these improvements, this paper can achieve optimal performance for ECG applications. For solving low power dissipation the operational amplifier can use Logarithmic compression which is used in Variable Gain Amplifiers (VGA) and Low Pass Filters (LPF). In addition, HPSDM's Op-Amp Sharing Technology can reduce the power, as well. The following two methods can solve problems that occur at high power consumption. For example, common-mode interference can occur, Right-leg drive circuitry and advanced amplifiers can be used in the circuits. With high power, wide bandwidth, high linearity, and low noise Microwave monolithic integrated circuit (MMIC) amplifiers can be used to reduce all these defects. To remove the amplifier noise, Pseudo-resistors are one method applied to ECG. Also, use a P-channel input device with an N-channel load because it has lower flicker noise. In the operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) circuit, a high-pass filter can be generated which can reduce unnecessary low frequencies. High-pass filters with sharp transition bands of trap filters can suppress the power line noise. In addition, the lock-in amplifier (LIA) is capable of extracting weak signals with great sensitivity.

articleTitle: Semantic preservation and stylistic decoupling in textual style migration
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the continuous progress of text style transfer technology, its importance in natural language processing is becoming more and more prominent, especially in machine translation, literary creation and other fields with a wide range of applications. This study builds on the work of Tikhonov et al. and provides insights into the problems with their proposed method for assessing textual style migration. Through experiments, this study validates Tikhonov's model architecture and further explores the applicability and limitations of the assessment criteria. The study uses a model that combines an autoencoder (AE) architecture with a Gated Recurrent Unit Recurrent Neural Network (GRU RNN) generator and optimizes the performance by introducing a dedicated discriminator and a shifted autoencoder (SAE). The experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in semantic retention and style migration accuracy thanks to the refined model. However, this study also found that Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) scores have limitations in assessing style migration tasks and may not fully reflect the semantic accuracy and fluency of the migrated text. Therefore, this study proposes a reflection on the existing evaluation metrics and suggests exploring a comprehensive evaluation system that is more applicable to style migration tasks. In addition, this study discusses the model's ability to generalize over different styles and domains of data, highlighting the need for further validation and optimization. This study provides valuable insights into the field of textual style migration by validating state-of-the-art models while providing insights into their limitations.

articleTitle: Research on control method of doubly-fed asynchronous wind turbine under complex operating conditions
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In the context of the global energy structure transformation, wind energy, as a renewable energy source, plays a crucial role in reducing greenhouse gas emissions and promoting sustainable development. In order to meet the high standard requirements of frequency and voltage stability, the operation control technology of generators is facing unprecedented challenges. As one of the current mainstream asynchronous generators, double-fed asynchronous wind turbine, its frequency converter, as the core control technology, shows the remarkable potential of optimizing energy conversion under the condition of wind speed change. In this paper, the working mode of double-fed asynchronous wind turbine and the core functions of frequency converter in the system are analyzed, and the specific technical strategy of double-fed asynchronous wind turbine operation control is discussed in detail from two dimensions of technical application and algorithm optimization. The aim is to comprehensively improve the operation and control efficiency of doubly-fed asynchronous wind turbines, so as to improve the comprehensive performance of the whole wind power generation system, reduce the dependence on traditional energy, and promote the realization of more lasting and sustainable energy utilization.

articleTitle: Research on bismuth-doped fiber laser in 1200 nm band
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, the rise of the data era requires the transmission capacity of communication systems to be further improved. As a medium suitable for long-distance transmission, fiber lasers are widely used in many fields. Among them, bismuth-doped fiber laser has excellent amplification performance. This article simulates a bismuth-doped fiber laser in the 1200-1250nm band through MATLAB simulation. It will first introduce the research background of bismuth-doped fiber lasers and give a general discussion of its research status at home and abroad. Secondly, it will introduce the quantum electrodynamics model of bismuth ions and demonstrate its energy level system, its electronic transition process is summarized and the relevant formulas are listed. The parameters used in the experiment are listed. Then based on the results of the simulation experiment, the relationship between the pump optical power and the laser power is discussed and summarized. , and finally summarize the conclusions and look forward to the future.

articleTitle: Recet advances in multilevel converter and impedance source converter for electric power engineering
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: New energy converters improve energy efficiency and power quality by converting electricity generated from renewable sources, such as solar and wind, into a form suitable for use by the grid or the user. They perform well in high-voltage and high-power applications, reducing harmonic distortion and electromagnetic interference, thereby enhancing system reliability and stability, and thus becoming the mainstream power components of today. This paper reviews the key role of multilevel converter in power grid, especially in electric power system, which can effectively convert DC to multilevel AC, reduce harmonics, improve waveform quality and improve system efficiency. This paper analyzes its working principle and topology, discusses its application in power systems such as wind power generation. Furthermore, this paper presents the application of impedance source converter in distributed energy system, which can improve energy conversion efficiency and system stability by matching impedance characteristics. These studies provide design references and implementation schemes for the application of multilevel converters and impedance source converters in power grids and distributed energy systems, which are of great significance for improving the efficiency of power systems and optimizing energy utilization.

articleTitle: Exploring its potential as a next-generation semiconductor material surpassing silicon
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Cubic boron arsenide (c-BAs) is emerging as a promising next-generation semiconductor material, surpassing silicon in thermal conductivity and electron-hole mobility. The study focuses on the material's potential in power electronics and optoelectronic devices, where heat dissipation is critical for enhancing performance and ensuring safety. Experimental evidence, including the use of optical transient grating (TG) techniques, demonstrates that c-BAs possesses a thermal conductivity significantly higher than silicon, along with high ambipolar mobility. These properties suggest that c-BAs could address the limitations of current semiconductor materials, particularly in applications requiring efficient thermal management. The impact of doping on c-BAs was also examined, revealing that while doping is necessary for certain applications, it can negatively affect the material's thermal conductivity. The challenges in producing c-BAs in sufficient quantities and with consistent quality remain, but its remarkable combination of thermal and electrical properties positions it as a potential game-changer in the semiconductor industry. This study underscores the need for further research to fully realize the commercial potential of c-BAs, particularly in high-performance electronics.

articleTitle: Systematic comparison of solid-state batteries and lithium-ion batteries
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This paper primarily compares the characteristics of lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) and solid-state batteries in terms of temperature adaptability, energy density, and cycle life, and discusses the challenges and future prospects faced by solid-state batteries. Solid-state batteries exhibit better temperature adaptability due to their non-liquid electrolyte and good thermal stability, allowing them to operate safely over a wider temperature range and effectively reducing the risk of thermal runaway. In terms of energy density, solid-state batteries possess higher energy densities expected to reach 400-500Wh/kg, far surpassing the 90-235Wh/kg of commercial lithium-ion batteries. This means that a greater amount of electrical energy can be stored within the same volume or weight, which is significant for enhancing the range of electric vehicles and reducing the size of portable electronic devices. Moreover, solid-state batteries also have a longer service life, with cycle counts reaching thousands of times, reducing long-term usage costs and benefiting sustainable environmental development. Despite the still existing high production costs and technical challenges in materials research and development, solid-state batteries are expected to overcome these issues with continuous technological advancements, bringing innovation to energy storage technology and pushing us towards a more efficient and safe energy future.

articleTitle: Study of a fiber laser based on bismuth ion doping in the 1300-1350 nm band
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This paper reviews the research progress of bismuth ion-doped fiber lasers in the 1300 nm band. Bismuth-doped fiber, as an active medium with broad application prospects, has an emission spectral range covering 1150-1800 nm, which provides new possibilities in fields such as near-infrared lasers and fiber amplifiers. Fiber laser is an important part in the field of modern optics, which has important research significance and wide application value. In science and technology, industry, medical, communications and other fields, fiber lasers play a vital role. In this paper, this paper use the theoretical model of fiber laser to analyze rate and power equations. This includes models of energy level jumps, gain coefficients, and losses in the three-energy level system. Based on the simulated results, the influence of various parameters on laser properties is studied. It is shown that the influence of the pump power on the LD and LD is remarkable. The research results in this paper provide theoretical guidance and reference for the design and application of bismuth-doped fiber lasers.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a deep learning based fall behaviour recognition system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Falls have become one of the common health risks in the daily lives of older persons. Falls may not only lead to serious physical injuries, such as bone fractures and head trauma but also have a profound impact on the psychological and social functions of the elderly. Given that fall behaviours are usually accompanied by specific body postures and movement patterns, a deep learning-based fall behaviour recognition system has great research value and practical application prospects. Analyse the recognition of fall behaviour based on deep learning. This paper mainly introduces and analyses the fall behaviour recognition of human body through a convolutional neural network and target detection algorithm. The research presented herein aims to contribute a novel perspective to solution in the field of fall behaviour recognition and provide a strong guarantee for the regarding their safety from falls. Meanwhile, the research results in this paper can also provide useful references and lessons for other behaviour recognition tasks in similar scenarios.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of adaptive PID control for DC motors based on adaptive boosting
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The application fields of proportional-integral-derivative (PID) are very extensive, such as automation, aerospace, autonomous driving, and other fields. More specifically, it can be applied to tasks such as temperature, pressure, tension, precision positioning, etc. However, PID parameter adjustment has always been an important and troublesome task. There are many directions and methods for the self-tuning research of PID parameters, and there are many different algorithms based on different scenarios. Among them, there are relatively few PID controls using the Adaptive Boosting algorithm (AdaBoost), and although there are similarities between various algorithms, each algorithm still has a unique advantage interval. Compared to other algorithms, such as mainstream fuzzy gain algorithms, the AdaBoost algorithm has strong adaptive ability, simple implementation, and a wide range of applications. Therefore, this article designs an AdaBoost algorithm logic and applies it to PID control, with DC motors as the target object for research. By designing a PID control for DC motors that can reasonably self-tuning parameters, the application and influence of the AdaBoost algorithm in PID control are studied. In short, this study designed the potential of the AdaBoost algorithm to improve the performance and adaptability of PID controllers in various industrial applications. With these advanced optimization technologies, more intelligent and autonomous control systems can be developed to meet the requirements of modern engineering challenges.

articleTitle: Comprehensive analysis of the principle and extensive applications of operational amplifiers in modern electronic systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Operational amplifiers, commonly referred to as op-amps, are fundamental components in modern electronic systems due to their versatility and efficiency. These devices, integral to amplifying electronic signals, are pivotal in diverse applications ranging from simple signal conditioning to complex filter designs and analog computations. This paper delves into the structural, principle-based, and functional aspects of op-amps, elucidating how these elements coalesce to facilitate broad utility across various electronic domains. The structure of op-amps is analyzed to understand their operational dynamics, which are rooted in their basic design principles that enable signal amplification and processing. Additionally, the paper explores the extensive functional applications of op-amps, highlighting their theoretical and practical implementations. From medical devices to telecommunication systems, op-amps prove indispensable in amplifying and managing electronic signals, thus enhancing the performance and reliability of electronic equipment. The research also extends to practical demonstrations where op-amps are employed in everyday electronic devices, underscoring their role in modern technology. By examining these aspects, the paper aims to provide insights into the continued relevance of op-amps in advancing electronic engineering and technology development.

articleTitle: Comprehensive analysis of emerging semiconductor materials: background, advancements, and their prospective challenges
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Semiconductors have become pivotal in shaping the technological landscape of various industries such as automotive and communications, where they are essential for innovation and efficiency. The advent of new energy vehicles and the expansion of communication technologies have significantly increased the demand for semiconductors that not only perform reliably but also manage energy consumption effectively. Advanced semiconductor materials like silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN) have emerged as leaders due to their superior properties compared to traditional silicon, including higher efficiency and greater thermal conductivity. This article provides a detailed analysis of the benefits of SiC and GaN in critical applications, supported by rigorous calculations and comparative charts. It explores how these materials reduce energy consumption and enhance operational efficiency, focusing on their unique band structures. These structures allow for effective movement of electrons between the conduction band and the valence band, which is crucial for the precise control of current flow and the reduction of energy losses. The discussion also covers the foundational principles behind the energy efficiency of these semiconductors, delving into the physical properties that make SiC and GaN advantageous for high-power and high-frequency applications.

articleTitle: The relationship between graphehe and airspace field
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In addition to its various applications, realizing aircraft lightweighting through the use of polymer materials can effectively reduce resource waste, improve economic efficiency and performance. At present, using composite materials instead of traditional metal materials is the most important means to reduce the weight of aircraft, and the amount of composite materials used in some advanced aircraft models in the international market can reach more than 50%. Polymer materials have a wide range of sources, good processing performance, good corrosion resistance, and much lower quality than metal materials. Applying them as composite material matrices in the aviation field can effectively reduce the weight of aircraft. Graphene is currently one of the strongest materials known, with excellent toughness and conductivity. When added as a dispersed phase to the polymer matrix, it can effectively enhance its mechanical and electrical properties. Therefore, graphene polymer aerospace composite materials are regarded as an ideal substitute for traditional metal materials and have enormous research value in the fields of aircraft functionality and structural materials. This article introduces the raw material preparation method, molding technology, and research on the application of graphene polymer composite materials in the aviation field.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of digital display methods: LCD, OLED and MicroLED
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the continuous development of electronic information and digitalization, various display devices have become an important medium for obtaining information. This paper makes a detailed comparative analysis of three popular digital display technologies: Liquid Crystal Display (LCD), Organic Light-Emitting Diode (OLED) and Micro Light-Emitting Diode (MicroLED). Each technology is compared in terms of its structure, operating principles, manufacturing processes, contrast ratio, and viewing angles to analyse and compare the unique advantages and limitations of each technology. LCDS are known for their cost-effectiveness and widespread use in in-vehicle displays and personal electronic devices, despite limited contrast and viewing angles. OLED offer superior contrast ratio and flexibility, making them suitable for high-end mobile devices, although they face challenges such as screen aging and limited life. Although currently hampered by high manufacturing costs, microLED feature high brightness, excellent contrast, and wide viewing angles, positioning them as a promising technology for future high-performance displays. This comprehensive assessment provides valuable opinion into the applicability of each display technology in various sectors and analyses the current market share to guide future advancements and technology choices.

articleTitle: Analysis on improve the image quality of MRI machines based on technical factors
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is a non-invasive technology which can produce three-dimensional image of issue. MRI is nowadays widely used to predict of diagnose a wide range of diseases. In this paper, it will be discussed that how can a balance reached among factors time of detection, Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) and resolution to achieve a relatively best quality of MRI image. Independently, high SNR, high resolution and long-time can all benefit the image quality. However, the former two are inversely proportional to each other and the long-time of detection is beneficial for those two factors but lower the efficiency of diagnosis and the comfort of patients. As a result, it is found out that the time should be adjusted to an appropriate range, approximately in the medium stage of detection, and the resolution and SNR should neither be too high, which are both accurately depend on the practical condition. This paper can contribute to the quality improvement of MRI images as well as raise the efficiency of the process of MRI detection.

articleTitle: Design and application analysis of arithmetic logic unit in digital systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This article consists of five important parts. Introduction, fundamental theoretical analysis of Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), Verilog coding and simulation, the application of ALU, conclusion. At the beginning of this article, the author will introduce the definition of ALU, ALU working principle & advantage and drawback and the development history of ALU. Besides, the author will show eleven screenshots of the code about design an 8-bit ALU with 9 functions, testbench and divider. After that, the article will illustrate the application of ALU. For example, ALU is applied in microprocessors and digital signal processors (adder and half adder) and three shifters (shifter for multi-channel selection switch, barrel shifter, logarithmic shifter). Finally, conclusion part will summarize the whole article. Through previous work up, the author's understanding of digital logic principles and practical implementation techniques has been enhanced. The experience gained will lay a solid foundation for addressing more complex digital design challenges in future academic and professional environments. The work in ALU design reflects the author's proficiency in digital logic and circuits, setting benchmarks for future projects and applications.

articleTitle: Exploring the multifaceted applications and future prospects of halide perovskites in the optoelectronic field
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In recent years, a significant number of experiments and research projects have focused on metal halide perovskite due to its unique structural characteristics and exceptional optoelectrical properties, especially in applications like solar cells and light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Despite its potential, metal halide perovskite faces notable challenges such as poor stability in moist environments and health risks associated with its lead content. This review primarily highlights recent advancements in the field, with a particular focus on enhancements in LED outcoupling efficiency and innovations aimed at improving the stability and performance of perovskite solar cells. Additionally, it discusses advanced formulations of halide perovskite, including narrowband, lead-free, and low-dimensional variants, which are being developed to achieve higher performance levels and move closer to commercial viability. The review concludes by addressing several pressing challenges and providing a critical outlook on the future prospects of this promising material, underscoring the need for continued research and development to overcome existing limitations and fully harness its technological potential.

articleTitle: Simulation of a PID controller for DC servo motor using octave online
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Direct current (DC) servo motors are extensively used in industrial sections that require precise motion control like robots, computer numerical control (CNC) machines, and aerospace systems. Nevertheless, conventional proportion integration differentiation (PID) controllers frequently encounter difficulties like adjusting parameters, managing system nonlinearities, and addressing external disturbances. Therefore, it is important to restrict their efficacy in attaining optimal performance. To tackle these problems, this work utilizes Octave Online to systematically simulate and optimize the behavior of the PID controller. The research employs step response and root locus analysis to determine the ideal PID parameters that improve system stability, decrease overshoot, and minimize settling time. The research results demonstrate that the enhanced PID controller offers a rapid rising time, minimal overshoot, quick settling time and strong stability. This paper presents viewpoints on improving PID control for DC servo motors and suggests a workable solution that can greatly enhance performance in a range of industrial applications.

articleTitle: Systematic analysis to the evolution and future of computer storage system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In the rapidly advancing digital age, the demand for efficient and reliable data storage systems has grown exponentially. From personal computing to enterprise data management, the ability to store and retrieve vast amounts of information swiftly and securely is crucial. This essay explores the evolution and performance evaluation of data storage systems, delving into the challenges they face and the future trends shaping the industry. It begins by tracing the history of storage technologies from early mechanical systems like punch cards to modern solid-state drives (SSDs). The essay then identifies key performance indicators, including speed, capacity, and reliability, and outlines methodologies for testing storage systems such as benchmarking, profiling, and simulation. A comparative analysis of different storage technologies, including Hard Disk Drives (HDDs), SSDs, magnetic tape, and optical storage, is provided. The discussion extends to the challenges of data security, scalability, and energy efficiency, offering solutions like encryption, distributed storage architectures, and green data centers. Finally, the essay looks ahead to emerging trends in storage technology, such as quantum memory, molecular and Deoxyribonucleic Acid (DNA) storage, and holographic storage, highlighting their potential to revolutionize data storage in the future.

articleTitle: Exploring of the defect detection in arc additive manufacturing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Arc Additive Manufacturing (AAM) is a rapidly evolving three-dimensional printing technology with great potential in manufacturing complex metal components. However, as the size and complexity of components increase, the generation of defects has become an important factor limiting its wide application. This paper provides a comprehensive discussion of the common types of defects and their causes in arc additive manufacturing, focusing on the various methods and techniques currently applied to detect these defects. From traditional Non Destructive Testing (NDT) techniques to emerging methods based on machine learning and artificial intelligence, traditional NDT techniques such as X-ray imaging and ultrasonic inspection have improved in terms of detection accuracy and speed. In contrast, emerging methods based on machine learning and artificial intelligence have demonstrated the potential to improve detection efficiency and accuracy. Nonetheless, there are still challenges to achieving comprehensive defect detection, including problems in technology integration, data acquisition, and algorithm optimization. This paper explores their potential and limitations in improving manufacturing quality and productivity.

articleTitle: Research on wireless charging transmission characteristics of electric vehicles
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: As an important direction to realize efficient and convenient charging, wireless charging technology for electric vehicles obtains abundant attention and research. Wireless charging technology for electric vehicles (EVs) has garnered significant attention. Firstly, this paper compares various wireless power transmission technologies and different types of compensation topologies. Secondly, this paper chooses magnetic coupling resonant wireless charging with SS-type compensation as an example, and deduces output power and transmission efficiency using various coil mutual inductance and load resistance values through the basic compensation capacitance expression. Then the results were analyzed through MATLAB programming and a diagram, the coupling characteristics and load characteristics of the wireless charging method of electric vehicles with SS-type compensation were obtained. It was concluded that transmission efficiency was positively impacted by the coupling mechanism's coupling coefficient as well as the choice of suitable load resistance. It offers some theoretical backing for the real-world implementation of electric automobiles’ wireless charging.

articleTitle: AI-driven circuit simulation and optimization
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: AI-driven circuit simulation and optimization have revolutionized electrical engineering, offering unprecedented advancements in the design and analysis of electronic circuits. By harnessing the power of machine learning algorithms and sophisticated optimization techniques, AI models efficiently simulate intricate circuits, accurately predict system behavior, and swiftly identify optimal component values to meet specific design criteria. These methods significantly outperform traditional simulation tools in terms of speed, accuracy, and resource efficiency, enabling rapid iteration cycles and more robust designs. This paper delves into the diverse applications of AI in circuit simulation, exploring various optimization strategies and their implementation. It presents compelling case studies that demonstrate the remarkable effectiveness of AI-driven methods in achieving superior circuit performance across a wide range of applications. The integration of AI not only streamlines the circuit design process but also catalyzes innovation in electronics, from everyday consumer devices to complex industrial systems. As AI continues to evolve, its impact on circuit design is expected to grow, potentially reshaping the entire field of electrical engineering.

articleTitle: Performance comparison and application analysis of SIC and GAN semiconductor devices in integrated circuits
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: As the demand for more efficient and powerful electronic devices continues to rise, the development of advanced semiconductor materials has become crucial in meeting the stringent requirements of modern technology. This paper investigates the growing significance of Silicon Carbide (SiC) and Gallium Nitride (GaN) semiconductor devices within integrated circuits, particularly emphasizing their use in high-power and high-frequency electronics. SiC and GaN semiconductors have become increasingly important because of their exceptional electrical characteristics, including higher breakdown voltages, improved thermal conductivity, and quicker switching speeds compared to conventional silicon-based semiconductors. The paper delves into the structural designs and characteristics of SiC and GaN devices, highlighting their advantages in fields such as renewable energy, power electronics, and telecommunications. Additionally, the challenges of defect management, manufacturing costs, and reliability in extreme environments are discussed. The paper concludes that despite these challenges, the growing demand for high-performance semiconductors in electric vehicles, renewable energy systems, and 5G networks positions SiC and GaN as pivotal technologies in the future of integrated circuits. Their adoption could significantly enhance energy efficiency and support the transition to sustainable energy systems, making them critical to the advancement of power electronics.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of a 4x4 multiplier using TSMC'S 0.18 µM CMOS technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In digital circuit design, multipliers are essential components that perform complex multiplication operations, integral to applications such as digital signal processing, embedded systems, and computer science. This paper explores the design and optimization of a 4x4 multiplier using TSMC's 0.18 μm Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) technology. Multipliers are essential components in digital circuits, performing critical arithmetic operations that impact system performance across various applications, including digital signal processing and high-performance computing. The focus of this study is to achieve an optimal balance between area, speed, and power consumption. The design process involves the creation of basic logic gates—such as inverters, NAND gates, AND gates, and XOR gates—which are integral to constructing the multiplier. The resulting multiplier features a compact size, low power consumption, and high-speed performance, making it suitable for a range of applications from embedded systems to high-performance computing. This work not only demonstrates the effective application of advanced CMOS technology but also provides valuable insights into enhancing digital circuit efficiency.

articleTitle: The application status and key problems of wireless power transfer technology in daily life
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, the traditional wired power transfer technology can no longer meet the needs of further daily use, so wireless power transfer technology has been developed accordingly in a way. This paper first introduced three major types of wireless power transfer technology, such as radiation, magnetic field coupling, and electric field coupling, and then the paper introduced their advantages, disadvantages, and some basic principles. The paper also analyzed the present application of wireless power transfer technology in the field of transportation and home furnishing. By using Multism and Matlab/Simulink, the paper also simulated the classical model of a magnetically coupled resonance wireless power transfer (MRPT) system, through which the paper summarized some key problems about efficiency and safety, which need to be solved urgently for further development in the future, and finally the paper came up with some new ideas for figuring the key problems.

articleTitle: Unveiling the future: the potential of graphene electronics
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Graphene, a material with a hexagonal arrangement of carbon atoms, exhibits remarkable properties such as high electrical and thermal conductivity, low density, and chemical stability, making it highly promising for various applications in electronics, energy storage, and sensors. This report delves into the production methods of graphene, highlighting the advantages and limitations of both chemical and physical approaches. Chemical methods like Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) and oxidation-reduction are identified as more suitable for large-scale industrial production due to their efficiency, safety, and environmental considerations. The report also discusses graphene’s potential applications, including its use as a transparent electrode, in hydrogen storage, and as a material for sensors, demonstrating its versatility across different fields. Despite its potential, the selection of the most appropriate manufacturing method requires careful consideration of factors such as cost, environmental impact, and production efficiency. This analysis underscores the importance of optimizing graphene production techniques to meet the growing demand and fully harness its capabilities in next-generation technologies.

articleTitle: Design of 1800nm-2000nm thulium-doped fiber laser based on numerical simulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Thulium ion-doped fiber lasers are valuable in various fields, including medicine, communication, and scientific research. This study aims to design a fiber laser within the 1800-2000nm band, and verify its feasibility through simulation analysis. The results showed enhanced forward signal optical power, reduced backward signal optical power, and stable final output power in the gain fiber. This research contributes to improving fiber laser performance, achieving efficient and stable laser output, and further application possibilities. The comprehensive insights provided by the experimental results serve as valuable references for future technical research, driving further optimization in structural design, fiber material enhancement, and performance improvement. Continuous efforts in experimental verification and theoretical discussions are anticipated to fuel ongoing improvements and applications in fiber laser technology, fostering innovation and progress across relevant disciplines. Furthermore, the findings from this research offer a solid foundation for advancing the capabilities of fiber lasers, creating the potential for more efficient and stable laser output in the near future. By continually refining and enhancing the technology, we can anticipate significant strides in the field of thulium-doped fiber lasers, opening up new possibilities and opportunities for diverse applications in various sectors.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of a PD controller for DC motor angle control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Nowadays, direct current (DC) motors are popular in all walks of life because of their many characteristics, such as simplicity and low cost. Precise angle control is critical for motors. Usually, the voltage can be changed to control the motor speed, but its position control cannot be achieved, so a microcontroller needs to be designed to control its angular position accurately. This research aims to design a proportional derivative (PD) control circuit to control the rotation angle of a DC motor accurately. By adjusting the coefficient Kp of the proportional control and the coefficient Kd of the differential control, the system can achieve a fast response and zero steady-state error while ensuring that the voltage of the operational amplifier does not exceed 15 volts. According to the set DC motor transfer function, this paper analyzes the most appropriate proportional coefficient and differential coefficient in octave, then uses Falstad for initial circuit construction and simulation, and finally uses Tinkercad for actual construction. By observing the output voltage waveform displayed by the oscilloscope, it can be determined whether the coefficient is appropriate. As part of proportional-integral-derivative (PID) control, PD control can be widely used in many fields, such as control of manipulators and aircraft, etc. Therefore, the position control of the motor is extremely important, and a PD controller needs to be designed to accurately control its angular position.

articleTitle: Sentiment analysis of twitter user comments based on long short-term memory networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the proliferation of social media, Twitter, as an important information dissemination platform, contains rich emotional information in user comments. In recent years, deep learning, especially Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM), has achieved significant success in sentiment analysis. However, challenges remain in processing short texts and the non-standard, character-limited nature of Twitter comments. This study aims to analyze the sentiment of Twitter user comments using LSTM. So a neural network model was constructed, including an embedding layer, dropout layer, bidirectional LSTM layer, and fully connected layer, and trained using the Adam optimizer. The study found that for comments with simple words and case-sensitive vocabulary, the sentiment analysis model achieved an accuracy of about 98%. However, for comments containing emojis and complex symbols, the accuracy dropped to 91%. Overall, the study results indicate that the model can accurately identify the emotional tendencies in comments and adapt well to different types of comments, achieving an overall accuracy of 88% on the test set. Additionally, the model maintains a high accuracy for comments with emojis and special symbols, and it is slightly higher for simple short sentences and case-sensitive comments. By adjusting parameters and optimizing algorithms, the model's performance was successfully improved. This study provides important empirical evidence and guidance for sentiment analysis of Twitter user comments based on LSTM, which has positive implications for improving and optimizing related models.

articleTitle: FPGA-accelerated simulation technology research to unlocking powerful computational capabilities
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Conventional software-based simulation methodologies sometimes face challenges in keeping pace with the increasing intricacy and scale of contemporary computing problems. This article examines the ability of FPGA-accelerated simulation technologies to meet the increasing requirements of contemporary computing. Field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) provide parallel processing capabilities and a reconfigurable architecture, providing a notable edge over conventional software-based simulation techniques. This results in enhanced speed, accuracy, and flexibility. The research examines the historical progression and present developments in FPGA technology, emphasizing its utilization in diverse fields such as multiphysics simulations, power systems, and machine control systems. The efficacy of FPGA acceleration in improving simulation performance is showcased using case studies and practical examples. Although there are difficulties associated with the intricate nature of FPGA design and its integration with current systems, the outlook for FPGA-accelerated simulations is optimistic. This is due to developments in AI-specific cores, heterogeneous computing, and the availability of cloud-based FPGA services, which are expected to facilitate wider acceptance and usage. This study asserts that FPGA-accelerated simulation technology is currently leading the way in computational innovation. It offers crucial tools to address the intricacy and magnitude of modern computational difficulties.

articleTitle: Design of an environmental monitor based on STM32 microcontroller
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the increasingly serious environmental problems, more and more environmental monitors equipped with multiple sensors are being developed. This paper reports an environment monitor that uses multiple sensors. It is based on a stm32f103 microcontroller unit (MCU) as the core, using a highly efficient design. The use of both Beidou navigation and Global Positioning System (GPS) can help improve the precise of the geographic information, with the temperature sensor, humidity sensor, noise sensor, Dust and other sensors to get multi-functional environmental parameters. These parameters can be read on a Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) and this product also supports linking with the phone, the data can be transferred to the phone via the General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) module. The author also tries to make it more portable, so it uses a battery to power it. It also adopts a modular design. Users can add or decrease any module for various goals. It also has a phone Application (APP) that can transfer text messages that contain all parameters, they are sent by the GPRS module to the phone app, in this app it invokes map Application Programming Interface (API), so parameters are shown on the map. After the test, results show that the system has good environmental monitoring capability. With good testing accuracy and robustness, it can fulfill the requirements of the design.

articleTitle: Research on commutation technology for HVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In the context of global climate change, countries have begun to pay attention to the construction and development of the energy industry, especially the power industry. The advantages of The High Voltage DC(HVDC) technology in long-distance and large-capacity power transmission make it a very important way of cross-regional power consumption in the future power grid. To find the most suitable converter technology for HVDC transmission, this paper starts with the topology and working principle of converter, comparing and analysing the technical characteristics and application scenarios of line commutated converter(LCC), voltage source converter(VSC), modular multilevel converter(MMC) and actively commutated current source converter(CSC). The research shows that although LCC technology is mature and low cost, it has commutation risk and needs reactive power compensation. VSC technology provides flexible voltage control, but it has higher losses and costs. MMC technology is superior to VSC in efficiency and harmonic control, but the structure is complex and expensive. CSC technology combines the advantages of LCC and MMC, has no commutation failure and the system is lightweight, but its technology is not mature. This paper compares and analyses the characteristics of the above converter technology, points out the application prospect and development direction of HVDC technology combined with the era background, and provides reference value for the progress of HVDC technology.

articleTitle: Emotion analysis techniques and development directions in social networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning and neural network methods have established themselves as the foremost techniques in emotion analysis. Their powerful abilities in feature extraction and pattern recognition have driven this emergence. Meanwhile, the surge in user-generated content on platforms such as Twitter, Facebook, and Weibo has underscored the need for efficient automatic extraction and analysis of emotional information within this content. This study examines the primary methods used in emotion analysis, focusing on Deep Neural Networks (DNN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), and multimodal emotion analysis techniques. The research finds that CNNs perform excellently in short text emotion analysis, with an accuracy of 0.91, making them suitable for handling local features. RNNs have advantages in processing long texts, and when combined with other models, they can better address the vanishing gradient problem, achieving an accuracy of 0.90. The integration of multimodal data significantly improves the accuracy of emotion detection. Despite significant technological advances, emotion analysis still faces challenges such as data diversity, implicit emotional expressions, and privacy protection. Future research should further explore multimodal integration and cross-cultural adaptation to enhance the comprehensive performance and application value of emotion analysis.

articleTitle: Application of organic semiconductors in flexible electronic devices
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Organic semiconductors (OSCs) are emerging as a promising trend in electronic engineering, potentially complementing or partially replacing conventional semiconductors such as Germanium and Silicon in certain applications. They have a large number of applications in flexible electronic devices because of their unique properties like outstanding mechanical flexibility, high biocompatibility and structural diversity. While Organic Field Effect Transistors (OFETs) are a major application, OSCs are as well applied in other flexible electronic devices, including sensors, displays, and photovoltaics. This research will introduce organic semiconductor-based flexible pressure sensors, flexible electronic skin, backplane Thin Film Transistors of Flexible Organic Light-Emitting Diode Displays, OFETs (including its application in flexible Smart Cards), Organic Transistors and Circuits, Solar Cells, Organic Light-Emitting Electrochemical Cells and Phototransistors respectively. These application categories can comprehensively demonstrate the characteristics and potentials of OSCs. This research will be helpful to the future advances of flexible electronic devices that may be related with organic semiconductors.

articleTitle: Research of FPGA-based neural network accelerators
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies has resulted in an increasing demand for high-performance computing resources. To enhance the execution speed of computational tasks, hardware accelerators are frequently utilized. These accelerators are commonly implemented using Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs), Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), and Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs). In recent years, FPGA-based neural network accelerators have gained significant attention in the research community. The inherent flexibility and programmability of FPGAs offer a robust solution for markedly boosting computational power in intensive tasks. This article delves into the research advancements of FPGA-based neural network accelerators over recent years, providing a thorough analysis of their performance, energy efficiency, and scalability. By examining recently published literature on the subject, the article summarizes the key academic contributions in this area of study. Furthermore, it sheds light on the future development trends and potential research directions within the field of FPGA-based neural network accelerators. This comprehensive review aims to inform and guide ongoing and future research efforts in optimizing these accelerators for more effective and efficient artificial intelligence and machine learning applications.

articleTitle: Systematic analysis of optimal design of EEG signal processing circuits
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) technology provides an important tool for neuroscience research and clinical diagnosis by recording electrical activity in the cerebral cortex. However, EEG signal processing faces several technical challenges, including signal interference, real-time processing requirements, and low-power design, especially in portable and wearable devices. In addition, the nonlinear and time-varying characteristics of EEG signal further increase the difficulty of processing. To address these challenges, the design and optimization methods of EEG signal acquisition and processing circuits are discussed in detail, and schemes such as advanced signal processing technology, modular design and high dynamic range amplifier are proposed to improve signal quality and system performance. With the development of artificial intelligence and machine learning technology, EEG signal processing will show broad application prospects in the fields of brain-computer interface and multi-biological signal fusion. The results of this study provide theoretical basis and practical guidance for further improving the design efficiency and application potential of EEG system.

articleTitle: Applications and prospects of MEMS technology in wearable devices design
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This article reviews recent advances in microsensors, micro-actuators, and micro-energy devices, highlighting their transformative impact on wearable devices and brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). Tiny sensors are holistic ways that capture precise physiological, neurological, and environmental data and are critical in health monitoring, fitness tracking, and environmental sensing applications. Micro-actuators enhance user interaction and device functionality by converting electrical signals into mechanical actions, providing responsive and intuitive control. Micro-energy devices, including miniature batteries and energy harvesting solutions, ensure the portability, efficiency, and reliability of wearables and BCIs, extend their lifespan, and support continuous use. The integration of these micro-technologies is reflected in applications such as blood glucose monitoring devices for diabetes management, heart rate (HR) monitoring systems for fitness and cardiovascular health, environmentally aware wearables for personal safety and comfort, and motion capture systems for sports performance, rehabilitation, and virtual reality. BCIs utilize microsensors to monitor brain activity and micro-actuators to enable neural control of external devices, providing breakthrough applications in neurorehabilitation and assistive technology.
