This review highlights the great potential of these miniaturized technologies to create more sophisticated, efficient, and user-friendly wearable and BCIs systems. The continued development of this field promises significant advances in healthcare, fitness, and environmental monitoring, ultimately improving quality of life and expanding the capabilities of wearable technology and BCIs.

articleTitle: Research on the improvement of sliding mode controller of PMSM
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This paper reviews the improvement and optimization methods of sliding mode controllers for permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM), introducing their basic concepts and significance in motor control. First, the application of the traditional sliding mode speed controller in PMSM vector control is described in detail, providing the relevant equations and theoretical foundations. The paper focuses on summarizing several improvement and optimization methods for sliding mode controllers, including improved observers, improved sliding mode control functions, and the design of new reaching laws. In terms of improved observers, optimizing the structure and algorithms of observers has enhanced the system's anti-interference capability and observation accuracy. Regarding improved sliding mode control functions, smoother control functions have been adopted, effectively reducing the chattering phenomenon. For the design of new reaching laws, several new schemes have been proposed, further enhancing the system's dynamic performance and robustness. This paper specifically discusses the advantages and disadvantages of these improvement methods, as well as the effectiveness and improvement effects of each method. Finally, the paper looks forward to the future development trends of sliding mode controllers in PMSM control, pointing out future research directions and potential research hotspots.

articleTitle: Applications of molybdenum disulfide in low-power semiconductor devices
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Molybdenum disulfide (MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) is a class of two-dimensional metal dichalcogenides inorganic materials that has layered structure similar to graphene. Although widely known as a lubricant, it shows even more potential as a 2D semiconductor in the electronic industry. Due to its excellent properties like layered structure and moderate bandgap (1.8 eV), molybdenum disulfide has attracted great research interests. As more researchers investigate its properties and applications, MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>has proven capable of overcoming drawbacks of certain materials. For instance, it addresses the zero bandgap issue of graphene and mitigates short channel effects in silicon transistors. Additionally, it enhances the performance of low-power (LP) electronic devices. In this review, researches on MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>’s properties, applications, and approaches to overcome its limitations are introduced to provide an overview of MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>as a 2D semiconductor in LP devices, including transistors, microprocessors, integrated circuits, photodetectors, gas sensors, and biosensors. Furthermore, the unique properties of MoS2, coupled with advancements in nanofabrication techniques, pave the way for its integration into next-generation optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: Research progress of humanoid robots and their application research and analysis in mechanical engineering
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Humanoid robots significantly enhance quality of life and efficiency across various sectors, including manufacturing and medicine. Traditionally, robots controlled by humans facilitated easier and more convenient work but have become resource-intensive and unable to meet current demands. Modern advancements aim to integrate digital and mechanical systems by connecting humanoid robots directly to computerized systems, enabling autonomous operations that could replace much of the physical labor performed by humans. Improvements in robotic structures are essential, focusing on precise design elements like the degrees of freedom in joint connections between components. Additionally, the adoption of advanced algorithmic control models, such as model predictive control (MPC), optimizes the motion capabilities of humanoid robots. Calculations from MPC equations, supported by extensive literature, indicate that this innovative design and interaction approach aligns well with practical applications, ushering in an era heavily influenced by digital and robotic integration. This evolution not only broadens the application spectrum of humanoid robots but also enhances the economic efficiency of their deployment in everyday life, promising significant impacts on future technological landscapes.

articleTitle: The application of spike neural networks in image processing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This paper is divided into three parts, firstly, it explores the implementation and efficacy of spiking neural networks (SNNs) in various image processing tasks. The primary focus is on leveraging the biological properties of spiking neurons to enhance image classification and feature extraction. Key experiments detailed in the paper include the use of the Caltech 101 dataset to evaluate SNNs for face and motorcycle image recognition, achieving high accuracy rates even with limited training samples. Additionally, the paper discusses the integration of denoising autoencoders and hardware pulse neural networks to improve image quality and recognition accuracy under noisy conditions. Another significant study presents a novel SNN model inspired by the human visual system, which performs wavelet transforms for texture analysis and classification. Lastly, a spatio-temporal interactive image classification model is introduced, showcasing improvements in memory efficiency and training speed across multiple datasets, highlighting the potential of SNNs for low-power, high-efficiency applications in complex environments.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of multiplier for computer signal processing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The multiplier, serving as the fundamental construct for arithmetic operations within computing systems, wields a significant influence in the domain of modern electronic technology. This paper describes the definition, components and working principle of the multiplier, illustrates the hypotheses pertinent to the optimization and enhancement of the multiplier, conducting detailed simulations and analyses of these postulates, presents designing and implementing a low-power, high-speed 4x4 bit multiplier using TSMC 0.18 um CMOS technology. The design employs a modified column bypassing technique to minimise switching power activity and optimise power consumption and speed and delineates the concrete realization of the hypothesis previously mentioned. The final multiplier layout is optimised for reduced area and delay, achieving a layout area of 9398 um² and a post-layout delay of approximately 1.3422 ns. The result demonstrates the effectiveness of the modified column bypassing technique in achieving a balanced trade-of between power consumption and speed in multiplier design.

articleTitle: Application of image recognition technology in agriculture
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the rapid progress of image processing technology, image recognition technology has become an indispensable part of artificial intelligence. At the same time, this technology is also widely used in various fields of agriculture, providing great help for agricultural production. This article explains the basic principles of image recognition technology and discusses its practical applications in pest and disease control, crop weed control, and intelligent agricultural machinery. Additionally, image recognition technology in the agricultural field also faces many challenges, such as the lack of lightweight image recognition models, the lack of comprehensive agrarian image databases, and the low recognition accuracy caused by the complex operating environment. Addressing these challenges will require significant advancements. In the future, it will be possible to build lighter equipment, enhance image databases, and improve identification accuracy in complex environments. Moreover, integrating machine learning and IoT with image recognition can further optimize agricultural practices, making them more efficient and sustainable.

articleTitle: Design of erbium-doped fiber laser based on numerical simulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Erbium-doped fiber lasers have been widely studied by academia and industry due to their excellent gain characteristics, high efficiency, good beam quality, and broad application prospects in communications, medical treatment, and industrial processing. This paper uses MATLAB's efficient numerical simulation capabilities to build a simulation model of an erbium-doped fiber laser. It then analyzes the laser's performance. The study first established the basic theoretical model of EDFL and the mathematical description of related physical parameters. These models not only include basic parameters such as the refractive index and doping concentration of the optical fiber. They also cover the dynamic process of the interaction between pump light and erbium ions. Subsequently, the corresponding simulation model was constructed in the MATLAB environment. This model integrates multiple key factors such as the transmission equation of the optical fiber, the coupling efficiency of the pump light, and the excited state distribution of the gain medium. Through a carefully designed algorithm, the simulation model can accurately simulate the gain characteristics. It also simulates the output beam quality of the laser under different pumping conditions. Through a series of simulation experiments, the internal power conversion and output performance of the fiber laser under specific pump power and erbium doping concentration were explored. This provides a useful reference for practical design.

articleTitle: Systematic analysis and application of magnetic resonance imaging
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: During medical technology development in recent year, The MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) technology get a wide range of application in different hospital to check issues in human’s body. In this article will mention two different types of relaxation time to explain which factors can influence relaxation time and to discuss about how does different relaxation time effect imaging quality in MRI. In this part, I will give specific examples of internal and external environmental factors that affect relaxation time. I will discuss how different speeds of relaxation time affect the quality of MRI imaging through three medical staff experiment. After analysing three studies, it was concluded that T1 relaxation time was longer in normal brain tissue and shorter in malignant tumours than in benign tumours and normal brain tissue and T1rho relaxation times were prolonged in cartilage regions affected by osteoarthritis, reflecting changes in calcium content and collagen integrity in bone. The significance of this paper is to point out the influence of relaxation time on MRI image quality, and advocate more cooperation between scholars in different fields to make MRI technology more mature, so as to better help doctors treat patient.

articleTitle: Application and optimization of FPGA-based real-time motion control systems in robotics
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of robotic applications in various fields and the important role robots play in technological innovation and high-end manufacturing, it is crucial to optimise their performance. Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) have greatly advanced control technology, leading to their integration into traditional robotic motion control systems, thereby enhancing performance, efficiency, and flexibility. The paper reviews traditional motion control techniques such as open-loop, closed-loop, model predictive, and adaptive control, then explores the unique capabilities of FPGAs, including parallel processing, data acceleration, system-level integration, and low-power design. These capabilities are analyzed in the context of improving sensor data processing, motion control algorithms, path planning, motor control, communication, image processing, safety, and power management in robots. The article demonstrates the advantages of using FPGAs for precise control, efficient data processing, parallel processing, and low power consumption in robot motion control. It reveals the great potential of FPGA technology in improving robot performance and efficiency. This not only provides a new path to enhance the adaptability and robustness of robots in complex environments, but also provides guidance for future technology development and industrial applications.

articleTitle: 16-bit multi-cycle CPU based on RISC instruction set
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a low-end CPU optimized for IoT applications. Low-end CPUs are critical in IoT and embedded systems for their power efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Our research focuses on key design strategies such as power optimization, RISC architecture enhancements, and CPU-FPGA integration for hardware acceleration. Specifically, this paper discusses various techniques including dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), sub-threshold voltage operation, and body biasing to minimize power consumption. This paper discusses various techniques including dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), sub-threshold voltage operation, and body biasing to minimize power consumption. Additionally, this paper explores the combination of CPUs with FPGAs to leverage their complementary strengths. Experimental results are presented from an FPGA implementation of the designed CPU, which successfully runs various functions including a running lights demonstration. These results validate the practical application and effectiveness of the design. Our findings contribute to advancing low-end CPU technology, meeting the market demand for efficient and low-power processors.

articleTitle: Multiplier optimization and application analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Multiplier is realized by the use of basic knowledge in the field of digital circuits. At present, the development of digital circuits has progressed from the past era of electronic tubes and other times to the era of integrated circuits, so in the case of the basic principle of multiplier unchanged, we need to explore more ways to realize multiplier. To expand the application range of multiplier, fit more circuit, used in different disciplines and fields. In this paper, using the knowledge of CMOS technology, BOOTH encoder algorithm and column bypass technology are combined to innovate the layout adjustment of multiplier, and the method of reducing energy consumption and delay of multiplier is realized. Including verifies basic electronic components (inverter, and gate, not gate, or gate), validation of a half adder and full adder, realized in the layout area of 9398 square micrometres, delay in 1.3422 ns. It proves that the innovation of the layout can improve the power consumption of the multiplier. Help multiplier used in more need under the condition of low power consumption and high efficiency, expand the application category of multiplier.

articleTitle: Bandgap in intrinsic graphene for semiconductor applications
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In the past, silicon was a very practical and widely used semiconductor material. In recent years, with the gradual development of electronic devices, people have been continuously searching for more efficient semiconductor materials to replace silicon and fulfill higher requirements. Graphene exhibits outstanding electron mobility and thermal conductivity, positioning it as a promising new semiconductor material. Nonetheless, the absence of intrinsic bandgaps constitutes a significant drawback, impeding its direct application as semiconductors. Therefore, this article reviews articles related to opening the graphene bandgap and discusses several methods for opening the graphene bandgap. The review identifies three possible methods: doping, quantum confinement, and substrate-induced bandgap opening. While each method has its unique characteristics, they also come with certain drawbacks, such as potentially reducing graphene's high efficiency or presenting challenges in control and implementation. The review suggests that growing graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) stacks may offer a potential solution to these challenges.

articleTitle: Research on FPGA-based detector for endangered birds
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In this paper, a monitoring system has been developed using Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) technology with the objective of protecting endangered birds. The system was designed by extending the capabilities of FPGAs and applying them to detect bird calls. To create the system, the researcher read and referenced various relevant papers, including studies on bird calls and signal analysis using FPGAs. The paper also looked at existing Wireless Acoustic Sensor Network (WASN) systems to determine their strengths in signal analysis, as well as referencing other systems that have strengths in signal analysis. Based on this, a novel FPGA-based detector is simulated. The detector can effectively determine the location and number of endangered birds in the area by analysing their calls. In addition, the system can self-improve through autonomous learning by neural networks to automatically update the data. The monitoring system can greatly assist animal protection organisations in tracking and protecting endangered bird species.

articleTitle: Processing web evaluations through sentiment analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The importance of sentiment analysis technology in modern life is increasingly evident. However, the current sentiment analysis methods have different performances in practical applications, and their merits and demerits them are still debated by researchers. This paper summarizes and compares the dictionary-based approach and a variety of sentiment analysis techniques such as machine learning. Taking the data on Amazon as an example, this paper aims to find out the optimal method through empirical analysis and provide a reference for further research in this field. The results show that, except for the SentiWordNet method, which had an accuracy rate of less than 70%, all other tested methods, whether using machine learning, dictionary-based, or hybrid approaches, achieved accuracy rates between 80% and 95%. In this work, a hybrid method combining dictionary-based techniques for preprocessing reviews and machine learning for sentiment analysis was proposed. The hybrid method combines the advantages of both and shows higher accuracy and stability. This method not only provides a more reliable basis for consumers to make decisions when using online shopping platforms but also provides an effective feedback mechanism for sellers, which helps to increase customer trust and sales.

articleTitle: Research on text sentiment analysis in natural language processing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Text sentiment analysis in natural language processing is an important means of understanding and interpreting human emotions in texts. It plays an important role in various applications, such as customer feedback analysis and social media monitoring. The topic of this article is research on text sentiment analysis in natural language processing. Four text sentiment analysis methods are reviewed: the method based on sentiment dictionary, the method based on traditional machine learning, the method based on deep learning, and the method based on hybrid method. By citing the literature on four methods, the paper analyzing the definition, advantages, disadvantages, and performance of each method in detail. The research results show that text sentiment analysis is mainly the method based on deep learning and the hybrid method. The conclusion highlights the need for continuing research to address the limitation of existing methods and improve the accuracy and applicability of sentiment analysis in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Application of GaAs in microwave integrated circuits
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The development of monolithic microwave integrated circuits (MMICs) has extensively leveraged gallium arsenide (GaAs) due to its superior electronic properties, particularly its high electron mobility and saturation electron velocity. These characteristics make GaAs an ideal material for high-frequency and high-speed electronic devices. This thesis first introduces the material properties and advantages of GaAs in MMIC applications, including its usage in power amplifiers and phase shifters. Secondly, it discusses the application of GaAs in MMIC control circuits and the challenges posed by emerging technologies, such as GaN-based devices. Finally, the paper explores future development trends and potential improvements in GaAs MMIC technologies. This thesis explores these aspects, providing insights that hold significant value for advancing the design and application of high-frequency electronic devices. The comprehensive analysis presented in this thesis not only contributes to the existing body of knowledge on GaAs MMICs but also serves as a foundation for future research, potentially guiding innovations in the field of microwave integrated circuits and high-frequency electronics.

articleTitle: Designing dysprosium-doped fibre lasers for 600-700 nm wavelengths
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In recent years, dysprosium-doped fibre lasers have attracted much attention in the field of laser technology. At present, dysprosium-doped lasers have been intensively studied only in yellow and blue light in the visible light band, but there is still a gap in the red light band. In this paper, the parameters of dysprosium-doped TZPPN glass in generating red lasers are investigated by collecting data from some previous literature. It is found that dysprosium-doped lasers can produce high-quality red laser light by appropriately increasing the pump power. In addition, the ion doping concentration has little effect on the pump power threshold. It is concluded that dysprosium-doped fibre lasers exhibit excellent performance and application potential in both red and yellow light output. The power level and performance characteristics of dysprosium-doped fibre lasers can be further improved by optimising the design parameters and exploring new materials, thereby advancing the development of laser technology.

articleTitle: Industrial robot control system research based on the direction of programmable logic controllers
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the rise of the intelligent manufacturing industry, industrial robots have also become a new development trend in today's industrial production and manufacturing technology. To understand and enhance the level of automation of industrial robots in the production process, to further achieve the precise control and coordination of the industrial production process. This paper combines industrial robots and automated operation and control under the guidance of Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) technology, as an example, to explore some of the applications and characteristics of PLC technology in industrial robots, and on this basis, in-depth excavation of the current status of the application of the technology and the prospects for development. In addition, this paper also found some of the current PLC control technology and industrial robotics applications in the field of problems, such as PLC control technology has low compatibility and the operator interface is not convenient enough, industrial robots in the existing industrial production and manufacturing technology is not enough precision, and in the production process may receive electromagnetic or noise interference and other issues. At the same time, some examples illustrate the use of PLC-related technology to solve the above problems, such as the use of soft PLC technology to improve the compatibility of the control system the convenience of the operator interface, and so on. This paper can provide new research ideas and innovative points for the two technologies in the future development and promote the further development of PLC technology in industrial robotics.

articleTitle: Impact of different semiconductor materials on chargers
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This study investigates how semiconductor materials influence charger efficiency amid growing power requirements and technological progress. The research emphasizes wide bandgap (WBG) compounds, particularly silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN), as potential replacements for conventional silicon-based power semiconductors. These innovative materials demonstrate exceptional capabilities regarding operational voltages, thermal resistance, and frequency ranges, rendering them ideal for high-power applications. The research examines the functional structure of power converters and discusses how WBG semiconductors influence various components, including filters, energy buffers, and cooling systems. The paper also compares the thermal management capabilities, cost considerations, and compatibility issues of different semiconductor materials. The findings suggest that while GaN and SiC demonstrate significant advantages in high-frequency applications and thermal efficiency, factors such as production costs and market demands play crucial roles in material selection for charger design. The study concludes by highlighting the potential of WBG materials in meeting the growing demand for fast charging and high energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Systematic analysis of double electric layer capacitors in modern energy storage
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The article discusses the operational principle and structure of double-layer capacitors, which rapidly convert and store electrical energy through electrostatic interactions between charges. Based on Helmholtz's interface double electric layer theory, these capacitors create two ion layers on each electrode when charged, with the Helmholtz layer separating them, storing energy in an electric field. Electrodes with high specific surface areas facilitate significant capacitance by allowing more ions to accumulate. The energy storage mechanism is reversible, exceling in enduring countless charge and discharge cycles and it does not decay obviously. Performance evaluation involves assessing energy and power densities, which are crucial for applications like extending driving ranges in electric vehicles or powering portable devices. Electrolyte properties significantly impact operating voltage and stability, with wider electrochemical stability windows increasing energy density. Optimizing electrode surface area, pore structure, and temperature range maintains optimal performance. The introduction of pseudo capacitance effects through additives can achieve higher energy densities compared to conventional double-layer capacitors. In summary, supercapacitors offer fast charging and discharging capabilities, making them ideal for scenarios requiring instantaneous high-power output. By improving electrolyte and electrode characteristics, their performance can be enhanced, broadening their applicability in various industries.

articleTitle: Design of erbium-doped fiber laser with 1500 nm wavelength based on numerical simulation approach
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Fiber lasers are widely employed in many different industries and have been the focus of extensive study in the past few years. This paper uses a physics model-driven numerical simulation method to design a fiber laser that can emit a 1500 nm laser with a pump light of 980 nm. The rate and power equations of the fiber laser are discussed through the analysis of its theoretical model, and the processes of absorption, emission, and nonradiative leaps are discussed through the analysis of the three-energy-level system of trivalent erbium ions. Finally, the model simulation using Matlab is used to obtain the variation of its pump power and laser emission power, and the results are analyzed to obtain the final design of the 1500 nm laser. This paper is organized as follows, which will first introduce the research method and theoretical model of fiber laser. Then, it analyzes and discusses its simulation results, and finally summarizes the results and presents an outlook.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of a UAV control system based on PD control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the increasing application of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) in various fields, UAV research is becoming increasingly important. Especially in the military fields, UAVs have a pivotal position and are valued by more and more countries. The control system is the brain of the drone and is the key to enabling the drone to achieve the required requirements. However, the traditional simple method uses simple proportional control to adjust, which can achieve system stability, but the response speed of the system is not excellent. Therefore, in this study, the design principle and parameter tuning method of the proportional-derivative (PD) controller are analyzed to design the controller, and the Octave is used to simulate and analyze the system. The simulation results indicate that the attitude stability and trajectory tracking of the UAV are effectively controlled by the PD controller, demonstrating excellent dynamic performance. To further refine the UAV control system, this study offers a theoretical foundation and point of reference.

articleTitle: Predicting short-term electric power demand using weather data
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This study aims to utilize a random forest regression model to predict electricity consumption, helping power companies better manage demand fluctuations, optimize resource allocation, and improve system efficiency. A comprehensive dataset was collected for the study, which includes various features related to electricity consumption, such as temperature, humidity, wind speed, and holidays. During the model training process, cross-validation and grid search methods were used to optimize the hyperparameters of the random forest regression model. The evaluation of the model's performance demonstrated the effectiveness of the random forest regression model in practical applications. The results of the study show that the model can accurately predict short-term electricity consumption, providing power companies with a reliable decision-support tool. This not only helps power companies effectively manage demand fluctuations during peak usage periods but also optimizes resource allocation, thereby improving the overall operational efficiency of the power system.The methods and results of this study provide valuable references for further optimization of power systems. The research proves the potential of machine learning techniques in electricity demand forecasting and provides a solid foundation for future research and applications. Through further research and improvements, machine learning models will play an increasingly important role in power system management, driving the power industry towards more intelligent and efficient development.

articleTitle: Research on the design and optimization of ALU based on Verilog for quantum noise stream encryption technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In the context of the rapid advancements in quantum computing and the disruptive impact it has on traditional encryption methods, this paper investigates the potential integration of Arithmetic Logic Units (ALUs) with quantum noise stream encryption systems. The research begins with an in-depth overview of ALU design, highlighting the fundamental operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, shifting, and logical functions including AND, OR, and XOR, with a focus on their implementation using Verilog. The exploration then turns to quantum noise stream encryption, providing a thorough examination of its theoretical foundations and its substantial potential to enhance data security. This paper also conducts a comprehensive review of current research on quantum noise stream encryption, summarizing the latest advancement and ongoing studies in the field. Through core analysis, the study explores the feasibility of combining ALU functionality with quantum noise encryption, presenting detailed simulation results and offering practical insights into this integration. The paper concludes by affirming that the integration of ALUs with quantum noise stream encryption is not only feasible but also offers significant potential, opening up new avenues for innovation that could substantially improve the security and performance of digital systems.

articleTitle: Research for the methods of text sentiment analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, as a critical technology for understanding and interpreting massive textual information, has been widely applied in public opinion monitoring and decision support for enterprises and governments. However, existing sentiment analysis methods still face challenges in handling complex semantics and contextual relationships. This paper provides a synthesis of the main current text sentiment analysis methods, which include approaches based on sentiment lexicons, machine learning, and recently developed deep learning techniques. Firstly, this paper introduces the construction of sentiment lexicons and their application in sentiment analysis, exploring the impact of different lexicons on analysis results. Next, it discusses machine learning-based methods, detailing text preprocessing, tokenization techniques, and the training and evaluation of sentiment classification models. Lastly, it analyzes deep learning-based methods, highlighting their advantages in automatic feature extraction and handling complex semantics. By comparing the advantages and disadvantages of various methods, it is found that sentiment lexicon-based methods excel in computational efficiency and interpretability but have limitations in dealing with complex semantics. Machine learning-based methods better capture features within the text but require large datasets and fine-tuned parameters. Deep learning-based methods perform excellently in processing complex sentiments and contextual relationships but demand significant computational resources and data volume. This paper proposes a hybrid model combining sentiment lexicons, machine learning, and deep learning techniques as a future research direction to improve the precision and speed of sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Applications of graphene in quantum computing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Quantum computing has emerged as a competitive alternative in computing, which leverages the principle of quantum mechanics to enhances the performance of electronics in various domains, including biochemodeling, material science and semiconductor technologies. Among the materials gaining attention in this field, graphene, a two-dimensional allotrope of carbon, has positioned itself as a promising candidate for numerous applications in quantum computing. It’s unique thermal conductivity, mechanical strength and and high electron mobility make it an ideal material for several uses in quantum computing, such as qubit implementation- the fundamental units for storing and transmitting quantum information- and carriers to enable various quantum functions. This paper will delve into the fundamental working principles underlying quantum computing and highlight its advantages over classical computers, such as the ability to perform certain complex calculations exponentially faster. Furthermore, this paper will illustrate why graphene is suitable for quantum computing and provide brief contexts about their combined usage in potential fields, based on recent research and experiments. This paper aims to contribute to the understanding of how graphene can be effectively utilized in quantum computing, potentially opening new avenues for future developments in quantum technologies and computing capabilities.

articleTitle: Design of self-avoiding car for disaster relief based on STM32
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the frequent occurrence of extreme weather and various natural disasters caused by global warming, the casualty rate in the face of disasters cannot be underestimated. In today's information age, it needed to reduce the casualty rate in the face of disasters by combining traditional rescue knowledge and modern equipment, so this paper decided to develop disaster relief vehicles. The rescue vehicle is developed based on the STM32 chip, combining the basic requirements of the rescue vehicle and other functions of the chip, capable of autonomous operation of the motor module, with obstacle avoidance function, Bluetooth connection function, pulse-width modulation (PWM) signal input. Finally, after long hours of hard work, field testing and code debugging, all functions can be implemented normally. However, there are still some problems to be solved in the future, such as the operation of cars in extreme conditions, such as sand, dirt. Or the tolerance of the chip under high temperature conditions because high temperature may cause chip damage. The emergence of disaster relief vehicles may provide a new idea for the whole disaster relief team - unmanned rescue. It has also played a leading role in the development of unmanned rescue in the future.

articleTitle: Systematic analysis and forecast the development trend of SSD and HDD
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In the era of big data, storage methods are continuously evolving to manage the exponential increase in data volume. Traditional storage methods, such as the mechanical hard disk drive (HDD), have been widely used for decades. However, in recent years, the solid state drive (SSD) has emerged as a mainstream storage solution due to its superior performance characteristics. This paper provides a comprehensive comparison of HDDs and SSDs, evaluating their respective performances, reliability, and market trends. Through detailed analysis, it is evident that while SSDs offer significant advantages in speed and durability, HDDs still hold substantial relevance, particularly in cost-sensitive and high-capacity applications. The research forecasts that SSDs will continue to gain market share, driven by technological advancements and decreasing costs. Nevertheless, HDDs are not likely to be entirely replaced in the foreseeable future, as their unique benefits ensure their continued use in specific scenarios. This study aims to enhance the understanding of HDDs and SSDs, offering valuable insights for future storage choices.

articleTitle: Research on wireless charging efficiency of electric vehicles based on magnetic resonance charging
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Nowadays, electric vehicles are developing rapidly, but the most common wired charging method has some shortcomings and hidden dangers such as the charging interface is easy to wear and aging, the charging line needs to be manually inserted and removed, and the operation may lead to some hidden dangers such as a motor short circuit. Wireless charging can solve these problems, but wireless charging still has a lot of challenges in terms of charging efficiency. Based on this, this paper mainly studies the charging efficiency of magnetic resonance wireless charging for electric vehicles. This paper first outlines the research background, and expounds the significance of the research. Then three kinds of wireless charging methods commonly used at present are theoretically expounded, and the magnetic resonance charging that this paper mainly studies is simulated. Then the influencing factors of wireless charging performance are analyzed, and how to improve the efficiency of wireless charging is analyzed from the aspect of transmission distance, and finally the scheme to improve the efficiency is given. Based on the research on the wireless charging efficiency, this research results of this project will provide a new method and way to improve the charging efficiency of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on news headlines classification based on long short term model-text recurrent neural network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In the traditional Natural Language Process (NLP) neighborhood, there is a work that must be discussed called "text classification", which is widely used in sentiment analysis, news recommendation, and spam detection. The development of text classification techniques has evolved from manual rules and math statistical methods to machine learning and deep learning. With advancements in self-supervised learning and multimodal learning, text classification is becoming more intelligent and efficient. This study focuses on exploring the application performance of the TextRNN model in news headline classification. An experiment conducted on the public dataset show that TextRNN performs excellently in multiple evaluation metrics. The model effectively captures the semantics and contextual information in news headlines, making it particularly suitable for handling short-text news headline data. This paper provides a detailed experimental design and conducts an in-depth analysis of different parameter settings and model optimization strategies to ensure the scientific validity and reliability of the experimental results. Based on the trained TextRNN model, it can quickly and accurately predict the classification of user-input news texts, resulting in a text classification model applicable to real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Advancements and challenges in semiconductor technology: a detailed examination of Gallium Nitride
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The rapid advancement of semiconductor technology significantly influences various aspects of modern society by introducing new materials and sophisticated devices that enhance efficiency and performance. Among these materials, Gallium Nitride (GaN) has emerged as a promising semiconductor due to its unique physical and chemical properties. This paper provides a detailed examination of GaN, exploring its properties, advantages, disadvantages, and applications, as well as its role in the future of semiconductor materials. GaN, an inorganic compound with a direct bandgap of 3.4 eV, exhibits a hexagonal wurtzite structure. Its superior electron mobility and saturation drift velocity contribute to its effectiveness in radio frequency and microwave electronic devices. The examination of GaN highlights its potential to revolutionize various industries by enabling high-speed, high-frequency applications and supporting the burgeoning demands of modern technology. Challenges related to the sustainable manufacturing processes, recycling of semiconductor materials, and global trade disputes are also discussed, underscoring the complexities and ongoing needs for innovation within the semiconductor industry.

articleTitle: Signal processing technology of wearable devices for ECG measurement
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Wearable devices are portable, dynamic, real-time and continuous, and play an increasingly important role in areas such as physiological monitoring and disease prevention. Electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring has important clinical value in the diagnosis, prevention and rehabilitation of cardiovascular diseases. With the rapid development of the element of Internet like artificial intelligence, big data and other technologies, wearable ECG is playing an increasingly important role. This paper presents the application of wearable technology in health monitoring and how different types of wearable devices (for example, smartwatches, wearable fetal ECG monitoring systems) can monitor physiological data (for instance, heart rate, blood pressure) in real time. Explored signal processing techniques used to process biological signals (for example, electrocardiograms), illustrated typical circuit design, electrocardiographic equipment. It also studied different types of denoising methods in wearable device design considerations to effectively restore ECG signal, and the design of low-power circuits. Finally, existing problems in cardiac monitoring with wearable devices are discussed, and development opportunities and future challenges are envisioned.

articleTitle: Exploring the application of the μA417 OP-AMP in modern electronics
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This article examines the μA417 operational amplifier (Op-Amp), discussing its internal structure, core principles, benefits, and limitations through a comprehensive review of scholarly articles and authoritative resources. Introduced as a successor to earlier models, the μA417 Op-Amp represents a significant advancement in electronic component design, offering enhanced stability and reduced power consumption. It is especially noted for its flexibility in voltage operation ranges and its robust performance in various analog processing applications. Despite its advantages, the μA417 faces challenges such as high input offset voltage and limited output drive, which restrict its utility in high-precision, low-noise environments. The examination underscores the necessity for ongoing research to innovate and refine Op-Amp technologies, emphasizing improvements in power efficiency and noise reduction to expand its applications in modern electronics. The analysis also highlights the potential of integrating these components into more complex digital systems, proposing a focus on nano-scale integration to push the current boundaries of Op-Amp functionalities.

articleTitle: Research on control of DC servo motor angle based on fuzzy PID
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Direct current (DC) servo motors have been widely used in industrial system design, with most implementations using the traditional proportional integral derivative (PID) control strategy. However, the parameters of traditional PID controllers - proportional, derivative, and integral gains - are fixed, and cannot be dynamically adjusted. This could lead to poor control performance in certain systems. Therefore, to address this issue and improve the system’s transient response, this paper uses a fuzzy self-adaptive PD controller to control a specific DC servo angle system. In this approach, PD parameters are continuously adjusted based on the actual system response, achieving adaptive PD parameters. The experiment compares the step response curves of the system under a traditional PD controller and a fuzzy self-adaptive controller. The simulation result can be obtained by MATLAB & Simulink, and it shows that the performance of the system is significantly improved when using a fuzzy self-adaptive PD controller.

articleTitle: Study for text length impact on text classification accuracy based on the transformer method
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: One of the key tasks in natural language processing is text classification, while traditional text classification methods have limitations in processing long texts and complex dependencies. The Transformer model can effectively capture local and global dependencies in texts to better understand the meaning of texts and can process texts of arbitrary length. This study explores the performance of the Transformer-based text classification model under different text lengths. A component of the research methodology is utilizing the THU Chinese Text Classification (THUCNews) dataset, which comprises around 740,000 news articles categorized into 14 groups. Data preprocessing includes word segmentation, stop word removal, and stemming. Evaluation measures such as recall, accuracy, precision, and F1 score are used to fully assess the model's performance The Transformer-based text categorization model exhibits notable variations depending on the text length, according to experimental data. Specifically, long texts with large information capacity can usually provide more contextual information, which helps to improve classification accuracy. However, when the text length approaches an extreme, the accuracy may not follow this trend, possibly because the number of samples is too small or contains noisy data. The results analysis and discussion highlight the need for an adequate and uniformly distributed number of text samples varying in length to enhance the validity and generalizability of the experimental findings. In addition, special processing of texts of extreme lengths, such as data enhancement or feature extraction, can increase the amount of training data for the model.

articleTitle: Advanced strategies for addressing the heating challenges in Gallium nitride chips: a comparative analysis of inverters, embedded graphene, and piezoelectric effects
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Gallium nitride (GaN) chips are increasingly favored over traditional silicon in electronic devices due to their superior heat control capabilities and ability to handle higher voltages. This paper explores advanced strategies for addressing the thermal challenges associated with GaN chips, focusing on the implementation of inverters, embedded graphene, and the piezoelectric effects. GaN's remarkable properties allow for enhanced performance in high-power applications, such as in modern chargers, where efficiency and heat management are crucial. The comparative analysis provided here delves into the effectiveness of each strategy in optimizing the thermal performance of GaN devices. Inverters in GaN chips contribute to efficient power conversion, potentially reducing thermal load. Embedded graphene, with its exceptional thermal conductivity, offers a promising solution for heat dissipation, ensuring that GaN chips operate within safe thermal thresholds. Additionally, the utilization of piezoelectric effects can lead to innovative cooling techniques that exploit mechanical stress to generate an electric charge, thus offering a dual benefit in performance and temperature control. This research underscores the potential of GaN chips in revolutionizing the design and functionality of electronic components, paving the way for more robust, efficient, and compact devices.

articleTitle: Video behavior in intelligent video surveillance system based on deep learning
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Due to the limitations of traditional monitoring methods in environmental adaptability, the intelligent video surveillance system has garnered significant attention. The evolution of computer vision technology has facilitated the emergence of this intelligent surveillance system. Specifically, the utilization of deep learning technology in intelligent video surveillance has demonstrated immense potential in analyzing video behaviors and addressing real-world challenges. At present, several deep learning-based video surveillance architectures have been proposed, including hybrid CNN-RNN networks, two-stream networks, attention mechanisms, and transformers. These architectures have found robust applications in various fields, such as action identification, behavior comprehension, and detection of aberrant conduct. In this paper, the author first delves into the differences between traditional video behavior analyses and those based on deep learning. Subsequently, the author elaborates on the applications of the deep learning in video surveillance, highlighting its advantages and capabilities. After that, the author introduces several architectures of intelligent video surveillance based on deep learning, providing insights into their workings and potential impact. Finally, the author puts forward the improvement direction of intelligent video surveillance.

articleTitle: A study on motion control system for rehabilitation robot based on multi-sensor fusion
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Rehabilitation robots play a significant role in helping rehabilitation therapy. An effective motion control system is crucial for making the movement of rehabilitation robots precise, flexible, and intelligent. Introducing sensors into motion control systems can bring a feedback control system based on motion intent recognition, which optimizes the adaptive control for rehabilitation robots and provides a more comfortable experience for patients. The study aims to improve patient experience by examining the architecture, algorithms, and techniques of rehabilitation robot control systems. Actual experience indicates that feature layer and decision layer fusion are more suitable for the control system of rehabilitation robots. Due to the accuracy and high computational speed required for rehabilitation robot control systems, many novel algorithms and techniques have been applied in the motion control system to extract features, recognize motion intents and complete human-computer interaction. In the future, the challenge for rehabilitation robots is to develop more accurate and faster algorithms to minimize the usage disadvantage caused by latency; and to explore appropriate algorithms for rehabilitation robots applied in different settings.

articleTitle: DC servo motor angle control based on PID control system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In industrial automation, maintaining precise control of direct current (DC) servo motors remains a crucial aspect for enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of motion control systems. To better improve its accuracy and stability, proportional-integral-derivative (PID) control has been widely applied. However, traditional methods often have limitations, such as unclear system dynamics, incomplete integration of control algorithms, and unclear performance indicators, which restrict the development of fields such as robotics and automated manufacturing. To address these challenges, this paper examines the potential application of PID control systems to regulate DC servo motors, using tools such as Tinkercad, Falstad, and MATLAB/Simulink for simulation and implementation. This paper first discusses the problem of parameter tuning of PID control of DC servo motor angle according to the unit step response. Then a systematic approach combining PID control with advanced parameter tuning techniques is proposed. Specifically, it explores the effectiveness of genetic algorithms in optimizing PID parameters and improving the transient response and steady-state performance of DC servo motor angle under different operating conditions. The results demonstrate that the positioning accuracy of the DC servo motor has been significantly improved, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed method in practical applications. The research advances control strategies that are expected to improve the reliability and precision of servo motor applications, thereby contributing to the broader field of industrial automation.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of FPGA-based 6-digit 7-segment led display digital clock in medical settings
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In today's society, the pace of life is accelerating, and people are becoming more anxious, especially in medical settings where anxiety is more likely to arise. Knowing the accurate changes in time can certainly reduce some anxiety, hence it is necessary to add a clock. The content of the article includes an introduction to theory, a discussion of experimental results, and a prospect for future development. The introduction to theory includes: the concept of anxiety, an introduction to Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), an introduction to hardware, and the concept of a 6-digit 7-segment display. The discussion of experimental results includes: the introduction of multiple entities constructed in VHSIC Hardware Description Language (VHDL), and the analysis of their interconnection to form the clock function, as well as proof of the successful implementation through both software and hardware. Future development can build on the experimental results of others, making progress in areas such as body temperature measurement and remote communication. In summary, the article, set against the background of medical scenarios, introduces the concepts and content required for a basic clock. This means that the research has potential to cope with a variety of different scenarios and make various adaptations.

articleTitle: The research on the structure and application analysis of graphene electronics
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This report investigates the transformative potential of graphene in modern electronics, highlighting its exceptional properties and applications since its recognition as a groundbreaking material in 2004. Known for high electrical conductivity, superior carrier mobility, miniaturization capabilities, and flexibility, graphene stands as a formidable alternative to traditional silicon. These properties enable significant enhancements in device performance, encouraging the development of high-efficiency transistors and flexible electronic devices. Graphene's unique atomic structure allows it to overcome many limitations of conventional materials, facilitating advancements in electronic applications from consumer electronics to advanced computing systems. This analysis, supported by recent studies, illustrates how graphene contributes to innovations in electronic manufacturing, particularly at the nanostructural level. Additionally, the report discusses graphene's extended applications in energy storage and biomedical fields, underlining its potential to revolutionize these areas as well. Predictions suggest graphene will play a crucial role in the future of electronics, shaping new technological paradigms and enhancing existing devices with its remarkable properties.

articleTitle: Analysis of wireless charging technology for electric vehicles based on comparison of dual LCL-type structure and PP-type structure
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the rapid growth trend of the electric vehicle industry, the charging problem of electric vehicles has also come to the fore. This paper firstly introduces the research status of wireless charging at domestic and international level. After that, this article describes the three types of wireless charging. Specifically, the three types are electromagnetic induction wireless charging, microwave wireless charging, and electric field coupling wireless charging. Also, the paper details the underlying topologies commonly used in wireless charging. Immediately following this paper, the dual LCL type and parallel parallel (PP) type structures are simulated by using Multisim simulation software. This article compares the transmission characteristics of the two types. After comparison, it is found that the dual LCL structure is more efficient than the PP-type structure and more stable in transmission. Finally, based on the results obtained from the simulation, high expectations for the improvement and enhancement of the wireless charging structure for future electric vehicles are presented.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic power generation stability analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The photovoltaic business of China has developed quickly in the past several decades, and the proportion of photovoltaic installed capacity is increasing day by day. Now, China has the largest scale of installed capacity of photovoltaic. For the production of solar power is sporadic and variable, the dynamic characteristics of the direct current (DC) distribution network will undergo profound changes, and its extensive grid link will pose significant obstacles to the electrical system's stability. This paper analyses the different types of disturbances that may cause stability problems in photovoltaic power generation systems and analyses the main influencing factors and the stability reactions of the two disturbances. Compared with the evaluation method of the stability of the photovoltaic power generation system under small signal disturbance and large signal disturbance, the respective stability improvement strategy is proposed according to the corresponding eigenvalue. Finally, according to the existing stability approach, the research direction of stability of photovoltaic systems is prospected.

articleTitle: Trajectory planning and dynamic simulation of welding robot based on kinematics
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the rapid progress of industrial technology, welding robots are widely used in aerospace, manufacturing, and other industries, becoming a key force in improving productivity and reducing costs. As the core technology of welding robot application, trajectory planning and power simulation are of great significance for guaranteeing the welding quality and improving the work precision and efficiency. This paper provides an in-depth analysis of welding robot trajectory planning research and power simulation evaluation, which are the key to achieving high-precision and high-efficiency welding. It was found that through the optimized trajectory planning algorithm, the welding robot can achieve a smoother and more accurate welding trajectory, which significantly improves work efficiency and welding quality. At the same time, the power simulation technology effectively predicts potential problems and provides a strong guarantee for the stable operation of the robot. This paper looks forward to the future direction of development, the realization of welding robot autonomy, intelligence and environmental protection will be the focus of future research.

articleTitle: Research on the development of multilevel converter topology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The topological structure of multilevel converters is one of the keys to the study of multilevel converters. The multilevel converter has small voltage stress and good harmonic performance and is widely used in high voltage and high power conversion frequency occasions. It can effectively improve the production, transmission, and utilization efficiency of electric energy, and ensure the safe. Its function is a reliable operation in electrical equipment and power grids. This paper mainly analyzes and summarizes the topological structure of multilevel converters, and conducts a detailed review of its development, providing ideas for constructing multilevel converters that meet various occasions and have their characteristics. The article starts with a simple topological structure and then introduces a complex topological structure of cascaded basic units. Then, starting from different topological structures and combining the latest research progress at home and abroad, it explores new topological structures and new technologies of multi-level converters, providing new ideas for the development of topological structures.

articleTitle: Enhanced by numerical simulation incorporating bismuth doping, design of a fiber laser operating within 1350nm–1400nm wavelength range
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In recent years, as the existing and future fiber optic communication systems have increasingly higher demands for the amplification of transmission bandwidth, active fibers that can amplify the transmission bandwidth within the transmission band are becoming more and more popular. Since its first demonstration in 2005, there has been a significant increase in the use of bismuth-doped glass. Bi-doped optical fiber represents a highly promising active medium for near-infrared lasers and amplifiers. In this paper, this paper have studied the fluorescent characteristics of a large number of Bi-doped glasses and crystals in the 1000 ~ 2000 nm spectrum. Fiber lasers not only drive technological advancements and application expansion in related fields but also offer robust support for scientific research and industrial development. In this article, the plane design, the transition arrangement and the numerical model of the BPF are presented. This model is characterized by three levels, and it is explored that the effect of optical fibre and pump power on the gain band is studied by means of the solution of velocity and power equation. It is anticipated that when excited within the 800–900nm range, the laser will exhibit an exceptionally broad gain spectrum covering the low-loss window of entire optical fibers within the 1000–1600nm range.

articleTitle: Graphene: in-depth research, applications, and challenges in advanced technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Graphene, a two-dimensional material discovered in 2004, has quickly become a groundbreaking material due to its exceptional properties, such as high electrical conductivity, mechanical strength, and thermal stability. This review explores graphene's synthesis, applications, and the challenges it faces in advanced technology. The first section examines the mechanical and chemical exfoliation methods used to produce graphene, highlighting the advantages and limitations of each technique. The second section delves into the functionalization of graphene, focusing on graphene oxides and carbon nanotubes, which enhance graphene's versatility and enable its use in a broader range of applications. The final section discusses the integration of graphene in cutting-edge technologies, specifically transistors and solar cells, where graphene's unique properties offer significant improvements in performance and efficiency. However, challenges such as scalability, production costs, and integration with existing technologies remain. This review underscores the potential of graphene in revolutionizing various industries, while also emphasizing the need for continued research to overcome the technical barriers that hinder its widespread adoption.

articleTitle: Design of 4-bit multiplier from schematic to layout
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The 4-bit multiplier signifies an essential milestone in digital technology, illustrating the shift from vacuum tube technology to solid-state electronics. This fundamental component has been critical in the miniaturisation and standardisation of computing systems, establishing a foundation for the digital revolution that has profoundly influenced contemporary industries and the education of future tech innovators. This paper explores a comprehensive design of a 4-bit multiplier, carefully constructing it from basic logic gates (Inverter, NAND, AND, XOR) to more advanced components such as the half adder, full adder, and the complete multiplier circuit. Besides, this paper encompasses schematic and layout designs, strict verification processes through Design Rule Check (DRC) and Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) assessments, alongside extensive simulation analysis to ensure functional precision and optimal performance. Moreover, this paper examines the advantages and disadvantages of various multiplier designs while exploring their diverse applications in state-of-the-art areas such as artificial intelligence, signal processing, and beyond.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of static wireless charging system for electric vehicles based on double-sided LCC compensation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: As the electric vehicle industry swiftly grows, the conventional wired charging approaches have begun to reveal various challenges. Wireless charging technology which employs the use of wireless power transmission has more advantages compared with wired charging methods. It uses the principle of electromagnetic induction coupling to achieve non-contact charging, which can improve the security of vehicles charging. However, at present, the efficiency of wireless charging is lower than that of wired charging which hinders its industrial development. In order to solve this problem, in this article the resonant circuit was studied and the double-sided LCC compensation circuit was selected to explore and measure its influence on the output power under different coupling coefficients and loads. Based on this research, this article presented a static charging system design based on double-sided LCC compensation. The static charging system has been verified by simulation tests that it can effectively improve the efficiency of wireless charging. The results of this project will contribute to both the academic exploration and the industrial application of wireless charging technology.

articleTitle: A fatigue driving inspection system based on image recognition
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Driver fatigue is a significant contributing factor to traffic accidents. Using image recognition technology to warn against fatigue driving can significantly reduce the incidence of accidents and ensure road traffic safety. This paper investigates a fatigue driving detection system based on image recognition technology, aiming to monitor the driver's fatigue status in real-time through computer vision and machine learning techniques. The study concludes that current research methods include installing a camera in front of the driver to capture facial images. Preprocessing steps such as grayscale conversion and Gaussian filtering enhance image analysis accuracy. Deep learning algorithms are used to detect facial landmarks and calculate the eye aspect ratio (EAR) and other fatigue parameters (e.g., PERCLOS) to determine the driver's fatigue state. The research results indicate that this system performs well in terms of detection accuracy, real-time capability, and adaptability, effectively identifying and warning against fatigue driving, thereby reducing the occurrence of traffic accidents.

articleTitle: Research and application of graphene in construction
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Graphite is one of the longest known forms of pure carbon and is also common in everyday life. Graphite is a cost-efficient and flexible ingredient for paints and coatings, among many other industrial uses. Graphite possesses several features such as chemical inertness, fire resistance, electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, lubricity, UV stability, and flame retardant qualities when it comes to "expandable" graphite. Graphite is not harmful. Graphite can be used with the majority of water-based and non-water-based coating systems provided that rheological management is done correctly. Graphite is widely accessible in a range of sizes and purity levels, from big particles to 3 millimeter powder, with 80% to over 99% carbon content. Particle dispersion can be tailored to practically any liquid system's specifications. Graphite's versatility extends beyond industrial applications, finding its way into consumer products like pencils, where it leaves its distinctive mark on paper. Its unique combination of properties, including its layered structure and ability to conduct electricity, also makes it a promising material for advanced technologies such as lithium-ion batteries and flexible electronics.

articleTitle: Application of FPGA in sensor data fusion for autonomous driving vehicles
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In modern society, with the development of science and technology, autonomous driving technology has gradually been integrated into our lives. People know that the autonomous driving system is very important for cars of this era because this system can bring convenience to people, and the working principle of this system mainly relies on fast and accurate image processing technology to issue instructions to the car. This article will introduce a new FPGA-based system, which is a key component of data fusion in autonomous driving applications because it can achieve accelerated image feature extraction. In addition, by leveraging the parallel processing capabilities of FPGA technology, the system significantly reduced latency and increased throughput, thereby greatly optimizing performance. Finally, this paper proved the efficiency and scalability of the system, making it an important part of the data fusion pipeline of autonomous vehicles, and the future development and research of autonomous vehicles will focus on improving resolution support and improving feature extraction capabilities.

articleTitle: PD control simulation and analysis for multi-rotor UAV
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: The four-rotor aircraft has the characteristics of low cost, high performance, and high controllability. In recent years, because the four-rotor aircraft can complete the basic hover, trajectory tracking, formation control, monitoring, and super flip tasks, it has a wide range of applications in highway cruise, search, rescue missions, disaster relief operations, environmental monitoring, and surveillance. Many traditional control models have certain limitations. For example, the need to constantly update the model due to the change of the system with the parameter further increases the complexity of model predictive control. Neural network control is susceptible to external perturbations and the system stability is not high. Sliding film control is prone to jitter vibration, causing drastic changes in the control signal, overshooting too much, and reducing the control performance of the system. Relatively, PD control is adaptable, robust, low cost, and has a faster convergence speed. This paper studies the realizable PD control algorithm of a quadrotor and obtains the optimal parameter value by particle swarm optimization algorithm. According to the designed control algorithm, digital simulation of analog circuit construction is studied in this paper. The results of the simulation show the method proposed in this paper to seek the optimal control parameter with the particle swarm algorithm. The control system under the participation of this parameter has a good control effect with a short response time and a small overshooting amount.

articleTitle: Advancements and challenges in semiconductor materials: from theory to applications
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This paper explores the dynamic landscape of semiconductor materials, which are pivotal in powering a multitude of electronic devices, from common household appliances to sophisticated industrial systems. It delves into the historical development, structural properties, and the various applications of semiconductor materials, particularly focusing on electronic devices, solar cells, and optoelectronic components. The evolution of semiconductors has marked significant technological milestones, notably the shift from silicon-based to more advanced materials like Gallium Arsenide (GaAs) and Gallium Nitride (GaN).
