These advancements have revolutionized industries by enabling high-speed, high-frequency applications and supporting the burgeoning demands of modern technology. Additionally, the paper discusses the ongoing research and innovations in monocrystalline silicon solar cells, which dominate the market due to their high efficiency and cost-effectiveness. The research further investigates the challenges posed by the diminishing size of integrated circuits and the associated electrical interference that impacts device performance. By providing a comprehensive overview of the current state and potential future developments in semiconductor technology, this study aims to contribute to the enhancement of electronic device capabilities and the promotion of sustainable energy solutions.

articleTitle: Design of a bismuth ion-doped fiber laser based on numerical simulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the explosive growth of Internet traffic, modern communication systems have put forward higher transmission capacity and efficiency requirements. This study explores the design of bismuth ion-doped fiber lasers to meet the demand for improved transmission capacity in communication systems driven by emerging technologies. An abstract model was established using mathematical simulation methods, and in-depth research was conducted through MATLAB. This method can precisely replicate the fiber laser's operational state as well as examine the effects of various parameters on its functionality. The research results confirm the feasibility of the bismuth-doped fiber laser in the 1150nm-1200nm band. The research not only offers quantitative support but also thoroughly examines how various factors influence the efficiency of fiber lasers. This research fills the gap in optical communication technology, especially the design and optimization of fiber lasers. It provides new ideas and methods for performance optimization in optical communication systems and other fields. By optimizing the design of fiber lasers, the transmission capacity and efficiency of communication systems can be improved. This fulfills the expanding need for information transfer and advances the development of optical communication technologies.

articleTitle: Sentiment analysis of product reviews based on BERT_BiLSTM model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the development of the times and the advancement of technology, e-commerce formed by combining shopping and the Internet has become more and more important, and in just a few decades, people's daily lives have become inseparable from online shopping. Using the Internet to shop has become one of the main shopping methods today. In the process of using online shopping, consumer reviews often determine whether people will buy the relevant products and services. At the same time, consumer products also serve as an important indicator that allows companies to understand product defects and user satisfaction. However, due to the popularity of online shopping, the number of consumer reviews is huge and customers must invest a great deal of time and effort to get useful information from them. This research suggests a bidirectional encoder representations from transformers with bidirectional long short-term memory (BERT_BiLSTM) model-based sentiment analysis approach to address the associated issues. Throughout the study, streamlined Amazon reviews obtained on kaggle were used as a dataset with a sample size of 4 million with both positive and negative labels. First, adjust the trained bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) model, and the classification process was performed using a Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory, resulting in a validation set with a stable accuracy of 0.86. The outcomes of the experiment demonstrate that the BERT_BiLSTM model is significantly improved in accuracy and f1 scores in contrast to the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers with Recurrent Neural Network and BERT models, and when compared to the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers with Long Short-Term Memory model, accuracy and f1 scores consistently increase.

articleTitle: Application of semiconductor power devices in electric vehicles
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Semiconductors, especially semiconductor power devices, are widely used in many fields of science and technology today One of the rapidly developing areas which is automotive manufacturing is more inseparable from the development and innovation of semiconductor power devices, since automatic cars are an essential part in transportation. In this essay, the first part is about the different matterials like silicon carbide and gallium nitride which are popular in making semiconducting devices. Some properties, characteristics and differences will be list in the essay. Secondly, the essay is about the researching methods. In the last part, the specific application of semiconductor power devices used in electric vehicles will be introduced in this article. There are also a little space about the future prospect in the last part of the essay. This paper aims to contribute to the research on electric vehicle manufacturing and the application of semiconductor power devices in this field.

articleTitle: WSD task based on Chinese BERT model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) is a cornerstone protest in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), critical for applications like the machine translation along with information retrieval where the precise understanding of word meanings is paramount. Despite advancements, the task remains arduous due to the intricate nature of language and context variability. This paper introduces a novel approach to WSD by employing the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) base-Chinese model, which is the state-of-the-art pre-trained language model well-known for its bidirectional context comprehension. this research is dedicated to refining the WSD performance through the fine-tuning of BERT, capitalizing on its robust contextual analysis to discern the accurate sense of polysemous words across diverse linguistic scenarios. the paper fine-tunes the model with meticulous adjustments to key hyper-parameters, including the learning rate and maximum sequence length, while training on a specialized Chinese WSD data set. The outcomes of this research's experiments not only significantly surpass traditional WSD methods in regards to precision along with F1 score but also underscore the transformer impact of BERT in this domain. this research's findings advocate for the customization of per-trained models like BERT for specific NLP tasks, thereby setting the stage for future investigations that may encompass broader datasets, more sophisticated model architectures, and the real-world embedding of the models into real-life applications.

articleTitle: Operation principle of display device and optimization design research
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In the modern society, the display device has been highly developed for decades of years as there is a larger and larger need for electronic devices due to the rapid increasing in population and urbanization. The article first introduces the working principles of three main display technologies: digital tubes, liquid crystal displays (LCDs), and micro-LEDs. Digital tubes are primarily used in clocks, calculators, and electronic counters due to their simplicity, durability, and low cost, but their display capabilities are limited, making it difficult to present complex characters and colors. LCDs, with their high energy efficiency, good brightness, and high contrast, are widely applied in smartwatches and holographic storage, but they have drawbacks such as limited viewing angles and slower response times. Micro LEDs, known for their high resolution, brightness, and long lifespan, excel in areas such as technological innovation, chip design, and biosensors, but their high cost and complex manufacturing processes limit their widespread adoption. The article concludes by summarizing the current technical, cost, and societal challenges faced by display devices and suggests that future development directions could be promoted through government investment, material innovation, and emerging technologies.

articleTitle: Design of ASIC accelerators for AI applications
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: This paper explores the advantages, architectural advancements, and challenges of ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuits) accelerators in AI applications. Firstly, it provides an in-depth analysis of ASICs compared to different architectures. Due to their specialized design, ASICs exhibit significant advantages in performance and energy efficiency. For instance, architectures like DianNao and DaDianNao excel in handling large-scale neural networks by optimizing data locality and employing tiling techniques. In contrast, GPUs, while excellent in parallel processing, consume more power due to their general-purpose nature. FPGAs strike a balance between computational speed and energy consumption. The paper then delves into the Google TPU as a pivotal case study of ASIC accelerator design architecture for AI applications. The TPU's matrix multiplication unit and high-bandwidth memory optimizations enable high computational throughput and energy efficiency in neural network computations. TPUv4i further enhances performance by incorporating more matrix multiplication units and leveraging compiler optimizations, while also reducing thermal design power for global deployment. Innovations such as Optical Circuit Switching (OCS) and SparseCore integration significantly improve TPUv4's system scale, availability, and performance. Finally, the paper addresses the challenges of ASIC accelerators in AI applications. In high-radiation environments, edge-AI ASICs require radiation-hardened features to ensure reliable performance. In summary, ASICs provide unparalleled performance and energy efficiency owing to their specialized design, but they encounter challenges in high-radiation environments and thermal management. Through ongoing architectural innovations and technological optimizations, ASICs are well-positioned to play a pivotal role in the future of AI hardware design.

articleTitle: Techniques and developments in aspect-based sentiment analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Determining the sentiment polarity towards certain textual pieces is a crucial problem in natural language processing, known as aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA). This paper offers a comprehensive review of the recent advancements and trends in ABSA research. The history and importance of ABSA are first discussed, and then each of its subtasks—aspect word extraction, aspect category identification, aspect sentiment classification, and aspect sentiment intensity prediction—is thoroughly defined. The paper then systematically summarizes the main research methods in ABSA, categorizing them into rule-based, machine learning-based, deep learning-based, unsupervised and semi-supervised learning, and cross-domain and cross-lingual approaches. For each category, the paper discusses the representative techniques, such as dependency parsing, feature engineering, attention mechanism, graph neural networks, and domain adaptation. Furthermore, the paper highlights the commonly used datasets, evaluation metrics, and methods in ABSA research. It also discusses the application scenarios of ABSA in various domains, such as restaurants, e-commerce, and tourism, as well as its potential in public opinion monitoring and reputation management. Finally, the paper identifies the technical challenges and future research directions in ABSA, including multimodal, multilingual, and cross-domain ABSA, fine-grained sentiment analysis, sentiment cause identification, and the integration of commonsense knowledge and causal reasoning. This review aims to provide a valuable reference for researchers and practitioners interested in ABSA and to promote further advancements in this field.

articleTitle: Impacts of grid-connected wind power generation on the voltage stability
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: With the power grid input use proportion with new energy sources, also in a more extensive application of renewable energy resources on current electric system structure and have some different traditional electricity systems, leading to today's stability is worse than that in traditional electric type. In the face of these wind power variations, grid-connected operation will directly affect the voltage stability index for large systems. In this paper, the influential factors of wind power grid-connected voltage stability is briefly described and it analyses them from four aspects affecting wind power connected to the network; finally generate a new optimization plan for connecting on into electric gird including suggestion its developing research. Future research should focus on optimizing these methods for economic and reliable wind integration systems, leveraging advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and data mining for improved control strategies.

articleTitle: Application of semiconductor materials in biomedical sensors
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: In today's era of rapid development, semiconductor technology has become a key force to promote social progress and technological innovation. Everything from smartphones to cars to home appliances to medical devices relies on these tiny powerful chips to process information, perform tasks and interact with the world. In this paper, this paper discuss and classify the progress of biomedical sensor technology into five typical types of materials. These materials are polysilicon, carbon nano-materials and so on. At the same time, these sensors are not only highly integrated and miniaturized, but also have excellent biocompatibility and sensitivity. They are capable of high precision detection of various biomolecules. At the same time, the paper also mentions the shortcomings of the above materials that still need to be further studied and optimized. This paper discusses the importance of sensors for modern technology, especially in electronics and biomedicine. A series of diagrams of these examples help explain why materials with semiconductor properties are advantageous.

articleTitle: Enhancing hand-written number classification through dedicated hardware neural networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Intelligent Control (EEIC 2024)
abstract: Hand-written number classification is a pivotal task in the realms of pattern recognition and computer vision, underpinning applications such as postal automation, banking systems, and user interface design. While software-based neural network implementations have demonstrated substantial efficacy, they often face challenges related to processing speed and energy consumption, especially within resource-constrained environments. This study investigates the enhancement of hand-written number classification through the utilization of dedicated hardware neural networks. By employing field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), neural network architectures are meticulously optimized for parallel processing capabilities and minimized latency. The research encompasses the design and development of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) specifically tailored for hardware acceleration, followed by their implementation on FPGA platforms. Performance metrics are rigorously evaluated against conventional CPU and GPU-based systems, focusing on classification accuracy, processing speed, and power efficiency. Findings reveal that hardware neural networks achieve a notable improvement in classification speed and a substantial reduction in power consumption, while maintaining or even enhancing accuracy levels. Furthermore, the scalability of hardware neural networks is demonstrated, showcasing their suitability for deployment in embedded systems and real-time applications where rapid and efficient processing is paramount.
